Neural news readings run in the background, use one CPU thread and cache each story. Missing readings stay unavailable instead of becoming a guessed answer or a paid-model fallback.
Gamma clouds have a broader gray-white or deeper-orange body with a dark backing so they remain visible over other studies. The text toggle and full leftward extension are preserved.

Leaving the scanner cancels its unfinished board and news downloads so chart candles do not wait behind those requests. Queued AI news readings refresh sooner without stacking duplicate news requests.

releases.heading: Scanner chart warm-up, clearer data age, and gamma controls
items: Scanner ticker links begin warming a small candle snapshot on hover, keyboard focus or touch, then share that request with the opened chart. Candle requests have browser priority and different tickers keep separate data.

Scanner data age now distinguishes the newest and oldest ticker bars from scan completion. Its detail shows scan, API and browser times, plus the source's known delay or rate-paced refresh limitation. A stalled board download times out so later polls can recover.

Record-column AI marks now identify the earlier paper trade they scored and reject yesterday's, future, wrong-ticker or wrong-side marks. JEV TAKE marks require an accepted recorded paper trade and matching entry time. Trading thresholds are unchanged.

Gamma settings now include Show gamma text / number boxes. White and orange glow clouds extend left across the chart; hiding numbers leaves the clouds and strike guides visible. These settings follow saved indicator profiles.
Background recovery keeps valid chart workers alive. Paid JEV trade and news requests are disabled on this installation; the existing local AI model remains available for evaluating paper trades.

releases.heading: Quicker chart replies and compact mobile gamma
items: Cached chart history takes less work to prepare before it is sent, reducing loading delays when the scanner is busy. Candle, study, and signal values are preserved.
Gamma number boxes and settings text are smaller on phones. The collapse arrow hides the settings strip while the gamma boxes and white/amber bands stay on the chart.

releases.heading: Visible gamma boxes and a clear fix for empty volume
items: Gamma now starts with open interest. If your saved Volume view has no levels, the chart explains why and offers Show OI gamma when an OI estimate is available.

Strike rows now have a gray net box, a white put box, and a yellow/gold call box with small concentration bars and cyan strike guides, matching the reference palette. Optional white and amber glow bands highlight negative and positive concentrations.
P% shows puts as a share of modeled call plus put exposure at that strike. It is not a win probability. All values remain labeled estimates using the selected OI or volume basis.
Use the arrow beside Gamma to hide or show its settings strip while keeping the chart's gamma boxes and glow bands visible.

releases.heading: Optional gamma concentration on your charts
items: Enable Gamma concentration (estimate) in Indicators to see strike-level bars: cyan for positive and white for negative estimates, with size showing relative concentration.

Switch between reported open interest and cumulative option volume, choose a loaded expiry, and save the setting in your indicator profile. Values are dollars per 1% stock move using a call-positive / put-negative assumption, not confirmed dealer positioning or guaranteed pinning.
The chart shows chain snapshot time, missing-data coverage, and an empty state when no nonzero estimates are available. The overlay clears when switching to a ticker whose chain has not arrived.

releases.heading: Smoother chart updates on desktop and mobile
items: Small corrections to existing candles and indicator lines now update in place, reducing pauses while live charts refresh. Full history, study values, colors, and chart navigation are preserved.
Backfills and changes that add or remove historical study points still replace the complete series so old points cannot remain on the chart.

releases.heading: More reliable startup after Windows sign-in
items: Automatic startup can recover after its supervisor exits without getting stuck behind an old lock. Slow cold starts now have up to 15 minutes to finish before restarting, avoiding repeated initialization after a reboot. Once the app is ready, automatic recovery still responds to consecutive failed checks.

releases.heading: AI and Bot set up to run on their own
items: The nightly AI retrain now runs as its own low-priority program at 4:40 PM ET, after the Bot's last closing prices, so it can never slow the scanner or charts. An evening restart does not run it twice, and a failed run is retried at most once an hour.

It learns from the newest 40 trading days and is graded on the last 10, so it stays a few minutes long instead of getting slower every night. Today: about 4 minutes for 44,000 trades, same score (0.539).

Fixed: the AI's SPY / QQQ "% on the day" was measured from the 9:25 AM pre-market price instead of the previous close. With the right numbers the market view scores 0.534 vs 0.539 without it, so it stays off until the data says otherwise.

The Google Drive backup now also saves the Bot's trade history, the AI's training data and models, and the paper-trade records (learning-DATE.zip, last 7 kept), next to the trade database, keys and code.
Bot: the minute-by-minute price record is saved every 5 minutes and at the close instead of on every save, so it never slows the Bot.

releases.heading: The data decides whether the AI uses the market view
items: Every night the AI is tested on unseen days both with and without the market view (SPY, QQQ, breadth). The market view switches on by itself after winning 3 nights in a row by 0.005+, and off after 2 losing nights - nobody turns it on or off by hand.
Tonight: without 0.539, with 0.524, so it stays off (0/3). The AI model tab shows both scores and every switch.

releases.heading: AI score moved to the Record column
items: The dashed purple "AI 62%" now sits in the Record column under the rule's record (e.g. zs2 50% +7%), not in the Setup column. Tap it for what it means. FILTERS lists it under "Record column".

The AI now records the whole market at each trade (SPY and QQQ % change, last 30 minutes, VWAP, share of the board up). It does not use it to score yet: with 15 days it made the score worse (0.539 -> 0.524), so it is only collected for now.

releases.heading: The neural network can take over the AI by itself
items: Every night the neural network (deep learning) competes with the current AI model on days neither trained on. If it wins by 0.01+ five nights in a row it takes over the AI tags and the AI pick bot by itself; three losing nights and it steps back.
The AI model tab shows which model is in charge, its progress (now 0/5) and a log of every switch. Fixed: the nightly retrain now includes the day that just closed.

releases.heading: AI tag on puts treated like calls
items: The AI tag on BEAR (puts) rows no longer says the AI is a coin flip on puts: after the latest retrain it scores 0.556 on puts. The tap-to-explain text is now the same for calls and puts.
The Bot's AI pick book note covers calls and puts alike.

releases.heading: AI learns from its mistakes, the Setup column and the Record column
items: Every night the AI weights its recent wrong calls 2x and recent days more than old ones when it retrains.
It now also learns from each trade's Setup-column picture at entry (RVOL, Skittles, squeeze, ADX, % change, grade, sector), Jev's read of the setup, and its rule's Record over the 10 days before.

First retrain with these: score 0.515 -> 0.539 on days it never trained on; its picks +6.2% ROI vs +5.0% for all trades. The AI model tab lists the latest day's worst calls (said take but lost, said skip but won).

releases.heading: AI score tag in the Setup column + AI pick bot
items: Setup column: a dashed purple "AI 61%" TEST tag on BULL and BEAR rows when the shadow AI gives the ticker's Bot trade 55%+. Tap it for what it means (on puts the AI is still a coin flip). FILTERS has a matching "AI score 55%+ (test)" choice.
Bot page: new "AI pick" book next to News trade - only the trades the AI scored 55%+, with its own P/L, win rate and leaderboard. Scores start Monday.

releases.heading: Bot records every trade's option price each minute
items: From Monday every Bot trade saves its option's mid price once a minute from entry to the 3:50 PM close, so exits and trailing stops can be tested on real price moves instead of only the day's best and worst.

releases.heading: Permanent AI training data + neural-network challenger
items: Every finished Bot trade is now saved to a permanent training dataset that is never deleted (the Bot's own files are kept 180 days). The AI model trains on every day ever recorded.

A neural network (deep learning) is tested every night on days it never saw, beside the live model. Its score shows on the AI model tab. First run: 0.512 (bull 0.547, bear 0.489) vs the live model 0.515 - it replaces the live model only when it scores higher.

releases.heading: AI model is its own tab on the Bot page
items: The AI model chart and tables moved from the top of the Bot page to a new "AI model" tab, after Rules explained.

releases.heading: Cleaner AI score chart
items: The AI score chart is taller and zoomed to the scores, with a score scale on the left (0.45 / 0.50 / 0.55 / 0.60) and each line's latest value at its end (bull, all, bear). Nothing is drawn over the lines.
The bull/bear table is trimmed to Score, AI win %, AI ROI and All ROI so it fits a phone.

releases.heading: AI score chart shows without a tap
items: The AI model chart and its tables now open by themselves under the AI model line at the top of the Bot page. Tap the line to fold them away.

releases.heading: AI model line moved to the top of the Bot page
items: The AI model (shadow) line now sits right under the Bot page buttons, on every tab and on the Paper trades drop-down. Tap it for the score chart and tables.

releases.heading: Paper accounts in one drop-down; AI score chart shows now
items: Paper 3 and Paper 5 are now one "Paper trades" drop-down after News trade. The two paper panels on All trades are gone.
The AI model chart now draws right away from the 10 test days already graded (Oct 5-16): overall, bull and bear, with lines at 0.50 and 0.55. From Monday night it adds one point per nightly retrain.

releases.heading: Paper trades skip the midday chop
items: Paper 3 and Paper 5 now make new buys only 9:30-11:00 AM and 1:00-3:30 PM ET. Positions already open are still managed and sold all day.
The Paper tab note shows these times.

releases.heading: AI model dashboard: chart, bull vs bear, vs your paper fills
items: The AI model line now shows the score for BULL and BEAR separately. First run: bull 0.564 (a possible edge to watch), bear 0.480 (coin flip).
Tap it for a score chart by night (lines at 0.50 coin flip and 0.55 edge, starts after the second retrain), a bull/bear table, and how Paper 3 / Paper 5 trades did when the AI said take vs skip.

releases.heading: AI model score on the Bot page, every day
items: The Bot page (All trades tab) has a new AI model line: its latest score, whether it shows an edge, and its picks vs all trades. Tap it for one row per nightly retrain.
Score 0.50 = coin flip; 0.55+ on days it never trained on = a real edge worth a paper account.

releases.heading: Shadow AI model learns from every Bot trade
items: A learning model now scores every Bot trade and retrains itself each night after the close on all trades so far. It is graded only on days it never trained on.

Shadow only: it places no orders and changes no trades. Today it cannot yet tell winners from losers (a coin-flip score); it earns a paper account only if it beats your rules on unseen days for several weeks.

releases.heading: Paper 3 and Paper 5 tabs on the Bot page
items: Two new tabs after News trade: Paper 3 and Paper 5. Each shows that Alpaca paper account's real paper trades - P/L, ROI, win rate, orders - and the full trade table.
They follow the page's BULL / BEAR and Today...90D buttons; a range longer than a day adds a Day column.

releases.heading: Paper trade table always shows its columns
items: Tapping an Alpaca PAPER line now always shows the table columns (Time, Side, Rule, Ticker, Contract, Qty, Bot mid, Paper buy, Sold, Stop, P/L, Status), even before the first order of the day. On a phone, swipe the table sideways.

releases.heading: Paper accounts size by price and follow your exit plan
items: Size: an option up to $4.00 buys at least 3 contracts, more when they fit in $300 (0.25 buys 12, 0.50 buys 6, $1.00 buys 3); over $4.00 up to $8.00 buys 1; over $8.00 is skipped.
Exit: at +100% sell 20% and move the stop to break-even; at +200% the stop moves to +100%, at +300% to +200%, and so on. The Bot's own exit and the 3:52 PM close still sell whatever is left.
The Bot page PAPER table shows contracts held, each sale and the current stop.

releases.heading: Paper accounts use your picked rules on each side
items: paper3 (All trades): bull - your 14 rules; bear - rows 1-17 of the BEAR leaderboard (ABVX down, PUT2H/4H, Gap up lost yday high, SKIT, GO, Sector falling, MX A+, MOM strong, Market turn, RVOL, GO+, MOM, SQZ fire, star 1, Jev pick, News, Explosive).

paper5 (Jev BOT, Jev 10%+): bull - RVOL, CALL2H/4H, MOM strong, Jev pick, ABVX, MOM, ZS (no day-high), SQZ fire, ADX cyan, SKIT; bear - ABVX down, PUT2H/4H, ZS rule, Jev pick, SKIT, ADX magenta, RVOL, ZS (no day-low), Sector falling, MOM, Explosive, GO, MOM strong.

releases.heading: paper3 trades your 14 Bot rules
items: paper3 now places paper orders for the rules you picked, on both bull and bear: ⭐1, ZS (no day-high block), ABVX, Sector (moving), CALL2H/4H, News, Explosive, SKIT, ZS rule, Jev pick, Daily line $100, MOM strong, RVOL, C2H/C4H.
paper5 is unchanged: Jev BOT (Jev 10%+).

releases.heading: Bot places Alpaca PAPER orders on paper3 and paper5
items: From Monday the Bot sends real PAPER orders (no money). paper3 follows All trades for the picked rules: bull zs2, c2h, openPath, jev, sectorMove; bear jev, go, turn, dayLine, openPath, sectorMove, dayLine100, dayReclaim, call2h, star1, skit, sqz, momStrong. paper5 follows Jev BOT (Jev 10%+), bull and bear.

Each account: 1 contract, limit at the mid, max $500 a contract, 8 open, 25 a day, one per ticker; unfilled buys cancelled after 2 minutes; sells follow the Bot's exit and everything is sold from 3:52 PM.
The Bot page shows one Alpaca PAPER line per account with each order, its fill and P/L. Stop both by creating the file artifacts/paper_mirror_off.

releases.heading: Alpaca paper trading pages are back in the menu
items: Option Paper Trading and Stock Paper Trading are back in the left menu (admin only), below Bot.
They show both Alpaca paper option accounts: paper3 (Mag7 OPTION) and paper5 (Watchlist option).

releases.heading: Cloud labels: only full cyan or full magenta
items: The dim/bright shading on the 5M-W labels is gone, so each half is now plain cyan (bull) or plain magenta (bear). Full cyan = trend up and price above EMA 9; full magenta = trend down and price below EMA 9; a split label means the two disagree.
Whether each side is strengthening or fading is still shown when you hover a label. The green flag (fresh bull cross) and red label (fresh bear cross) are unchanged.

releases.heading: 5M-W cloud labels now look like MomoX3
items: Each 5M/15M/30M/1H/2H/4H/D/W chip is split in two: the top half is the EMA 9 vs 20 trend (your TOS script), and the bottom half shows whether price is above or below EMA 9. A purple top with a cyan bottom means the trend is still down but price is already back above EMA 9.
Bright half = that side is getting stronger on the newest bar; dark half = fading.
A green corner flag marks a fresh bull cross (EMA 9 crossed above 20 on this bar), and a solid red chip marks a fresh bear cross.
The labels use a monospaced font like MomoX3, and hovering a chip spells out both halves.

releases.heading: Bear-only rows refresh their studies every 2nd scan
items: Your call: a ticker that matches only the bear scan now refreshes its study columns (RVOL, SQZ, Skittles...) every second Watchlist refresh. Price, % change, the scan verdict and the chart arrows still update every refresh.
On a down day most of the Watchlist matches bear (217 of 368 today), so this takes a large share of the work off each refresh.

releases.heading: Scanner spends less time on bookkeeping
items: Schwab volume data, History saving and the bot's trade files cost the scanner much less time, so the Watchlist gets more of the computer.
The CALL2H/CALL4H arrow check now yields the processor to the Watchlist scan; arrows catch up between scans.
Watchlist now refreshes about every 110 seconds (this morning 144-200).

releases.heading: Watchlist refreshes sooner
items: The bot's News rule no longer holds up every scanner refresh while it looks up headlines (same headline picked as before, checked on all 581 tickers with news).
Saving the board and its History no longer delays the next Watchlist refresh.
The CALL2H/CALL4H arrow check reuses the candles the scanner just downloaded instead of downloading them again.
A ticker that newly matches gets its columns built alongside the scan instead of one by one afterwards (same numbers).
The Watchlist starts its next refresh 3 seconds after the last one instead of waiting 15-20 seconds.

releases.heading: Watchlist and Liquid Movers wait less
items: The scanner no longer pauses its Watchlist build for the chart-arrow (CALL2H/CALL4H) checks; those now run on their own, with the same arrows as before.
Liquid Movers no longer does a slow full rescan of its own that held up the Watchlist; it waits for the Watchlist's next scan and updates seconds after it.
Watchlist refresh is now about every 2.3-2.7 min (was 2.4-3.3 min). Still not under 1 minute - the remaining time is the scan math itself on this laptop's processor.

releases.heading: Liquid Movers stops rebuilding unchanged data
items: Liquid Movers now updates once per new Watchlist scan instead of 2-3 times with the same data, leaving more of the computer for the Watchlist.

releases.heading: Scanner lists refresh in your priority order
items: Priority is Mag7, then Watchlist, then Liquid Movers.
Liquid Movers reuses the Watchlist's scan of the tickers on both lists, so it updates seconds after the Watchlist instead of waiting its own turn.
Small lists (Mag7, Movers, EMA lists) no longer slow the Watchlist down.

releases.heading: Scanner refreshes faster
items: The list you scan (Liquid Movers) now refreshes as often as Mag7 and the Watchlist, about once a minute. Before, it updated only every 7-9 minutes, including at the open.
The scanner uses more processor cores, so every list builds faster. It still gives way to charts when they need the computer.

releases.heading: Scanner charts are kept loaded
items: Charts for the scanner list you are viewing (Liquid Movers) and the Watchlist are kept loaded in the background, so tapping a ticker opens on today's candles.
Up to 120 scanner tickers, each refreshed about every 15 minutes. Before, many opened on a copy from earlier days and took 30-60 seconds to catch up.
Right after a restart, allow about 15 minutes for every chart to be refreshed.

releases.heading: Bot page opens in about a second
items: 1W, 2W and longer ranges open in about 1-2 seconds instead of 10-20. Numbers are unchanged.
Totals refresh whenever a trade updates; new News marks can take up to 5 minutes to appear.

releases.heading: Bot uses mid prices only, and the range always matches the numbers
items: Every bot rule is now priced at the mid only. The Real (ask-to-bid) and Pro fill buttons are gone.
Switching Today / 2D / 1W quickly no longer leaves 1W lit over an older 1-day result. Only the latest load fills the page.
Best price says plainly that it can never show a loss: a trade that never rose counts as break-even.

releases.heading: Bot page no longer goes blank on Best price
items: Picking Best price switches Fills to Mid. Best price has no bid/ask, so Real and Pro could not show it.
Picking Real or Pro while on Best price switches the exit back to Your exit.

releases.heading: Bot opens with your exit and bid/ask fills
items: Bot opens with Your exit and Real (ask-to-bid), ignoring old Best price selections.
Wins, losses and break-even appear separately. Real-fill totals exclude open trades and missing quotes.
Trade contract and fill-price columns match the selected P/L calculation. Results remain simulated, before fees and slippage.

releases.heading: The chart's 🔥 squeeze flames now show in the Setup column
items: When your chart draws a squeeze flame (🔥) on the 1h, 2h, 4h or Daily candle, the Setup column shows it too, e.g. "🔥1h 2h 09:00" - premarket included, from the chart's own squeeze study. It stays for one candle of its timeframe; if the chart removes it, it shows struck through with the time.

This is separate from the SQZ tag, which comes from the scanner's SQZ columns (a different TOS script) - so the two can fire at different times (MRNA Oct 9: chart 🔥 at 09:00 premarket, scanner SQZ at 09:47).
FILTERS > Setup column has a matching "🔥 Chart squeeze" choice. Starts with today's scans (past days were not recorded).

releases.heading: History: SQZ fire tags back on past days
items: Past days in History now show the SQZ tag when the scanner's squeeze box fired - read from the saved boxes themselves (turned cyan, or white -> orange for a high squeeze). MRNA Oct 9: SQZ 2h at 09:47. A ticker that first appeared already fired has no saved change and shows no tag.

releases.heading: Bot trades SPY and QQQ on every rule; never SPX
items: SPX (and the other market indexes like NDX and VIX) now count as ETFs: they still show on the scanner, but no rule and no bot trade uses them.
SPY and QQQ are now traded by the bot on every rule, like a stock. Before, they were only traded by the Day Line rules. All other ETFs stay out of the bot.

releases.heading: SQZ fire tag now includes HIGH-squeeze fires
items: The Setup column's SQZ tag (and the bot's SQZ rule) counted a squeeze as fired only when the scanner's box turned cyan. A HIGH squeeze firing turns the box from white to orange in your TOS squeeze column, and those were missed - MRNA's 2h fired that way on Oct 9 at 09:47 with no SQZ tag. From Monday both count, on 2h, 4h, D and W.

releases.heading: SKIT tag shows the Skittles box's real colour
items: The SKIT tag in the Setup column is now filled in the box's own colour and says it in letters: SKIT↑ 2h-G (green = MACD cross up in an uptrend), 2h-C (cyan = 9/20 EMA cross), 2h-Y (lime/yellow = 4/8 EMA cross). Bear: M magenta, R red, LR light red.
Two timeframes that turned at the same minute in different colours now show as two tags. Tap a tag for the full meaning.

releases.heading: Jev's news ▲ / ▼ is stricter - and now right about 85-90% of the time
items: A ▲ or ▼ now needs three things: the headline names THIS company (no more "HD Construction" counted as Home Depot, or IonQ news tagged to Navitas), it is real news (not an opinion piece, clickbait question, law-firm ad or a repeated rating) and Jev is 90%+ sure.

Blind checks on Oct 5-9 headlines: arrows were right 64-66% of the time before, 85-91% now, and never the opposite direction. You will see fewer arrows. Note: even a correct read did not predict the next hour's price.

The same stricter read drives the News column, the NEWS ▲ / ▼ list and the bot's News rule. The ticker card now says why there is no arrow (for example "not about HD" or "opinion / valuation piece") and explains what Jev is.

releases.heading: Scanner: the Jev column is now "Record" - the bot's real result for the row's tags
items: The Jev score was tested on Oct 5-9 (16,700 reads): it predicted the next hour no better than a coin flip, morning or afternoon, and its news reads did not predict either. It is replaced.

The column (same place, now called Record) shows the bot's real 2-week result for the best Setup tag the row shows: win rate and ROI, e.g. "71% +25%" for LINE↓ before 10:00. Cyan = made money and won half or more, grey-cyan = small profit, pink = lost money. Tap it to see every tag's record. Middle prices - real fills are worse. Tags with fewer than 20 trades are listed but never used as the headline number.
Sort by Record to bring the rows whose signals have the best track record to the top.

releases.heading: FILTERS now match the Setup column; 💥 / 📈 tracked by the bot
items: FILTERS > A/A+ Setup is one list, "Setup column (same order)": every tag the Setup column can show, in the same order with the same name - ⚡, GO, GO+, MX A+, ⭐1, 🔥/🔸 SECTOR, LINE, $LINE, RECLAIM, ZS, ABVX, MOM (strong), FLIP, RVOL, SKIT, SQZ fire, ADX, CALL2H/4H, C2H/C4H, ⚠ Warning, 💥 Explosive, 📈 Steady - plus the grade letter. Each choice shows exactly the tickers showing that tag, and the box under it explains it.
Best setups, Best in hot sectors, News + momentum and Any chart arrow left the dropdown (they are not Setup-column tags). If one was your saved choice, FILTERS starts at Any.
The bot now trades 💥 Explosive and 📈 Steady as their own test rules (bull and bear) from Monday Oct 12 - see them on the Bot page in two weeks.

releases.heading: Setup column: 🔥 SECTOR added; unused choices removed from FILTERS
items: New tag in the Setup column: 🔥 SECTOR (a leader of one of today's two hot sectors) or 🔸 SECTOR (a leader of a sector moving now). Tap it for the explanation.

Removed from the FILTERS dropdown: Market turn, Hot sector leaders #1/#2, SOLO, OPT only, Strategy V2, V3, Daily 2, G, MOM any and ✓ JEV. If one of them was your saved choice, FILTERS starts at Any. The bot still scores them on the Bot page.

releases.heading: Tap any Setup tag for its meaning; Setup tags in FILTERS
items: Tap a tag in the Setup column (ZS↑, SKIT↑, MOM↑, RVOL↑, CALL2H, ...) and a box explains it in plain words - live scanner and History. Tap outside or × to close.

FILTERS > A/A+ Setup has a new group, "Setup column tags": MOM strong, MOM any, FLIP, RVOL, SKIT, SQZ fire, ABVX, ✓ JEV, ADX and any chart arrow. Pick one to see only the tickers showing that tag; the box under it explains it.
Market turn, Sector leaders, ZS, Short arrows, Daily line, Daily line $100, Gap reclaim and MomoX A+ now have their explanation in FILTERS (it used to say "undefined").

releases.heading: Setup column: only the strong MOM↑ is shown
items: The outlined MOM↑ tag is gone from the Setup column (live scanner and History) - it fired on too many rows. The cyan-filled MOM↑ (momentum up AND a strong trend on 5m and 30m) stays. Alerts, filters and the bot's MOM rule are unchanged. MOM↓ on the bear scanner is unchanged.
History days before today never saved the trend reading that makes a MOM↑ strong, so no MOM↑ shows on those days; from Monday History shows the strong ones.

releases.heading: MomX History: SKIT tags back on past days
items: Past days in History now show the SKIT↑ / SKIT↓ Setup tags too (MRNA Oct 9 09:31: SKIT↑ 2h 09:30), using the cross times the scanner's grade log recorded. Shown where a grade was recorded after the cross - most graded tickers, not every row. Squeeze-fire (SQZ) tags still start Monday Oct 12.

releases.heading: MomX History shows the same Setup tags as the live scanner
items: History's Setup column now shows the tags you saw live at that moment - RVOL↑, MOM↑, chart arrows, SKIT↑ and SQZ fires - judged at the row's own time. Before, History checked them against the current clock, so by evening most rows showed only the letter (MRNA Oct 9 09:31: live "SKIT↑ 2h 09:30 · RVOL↑ 5m", History just "A").

SKIT↑ and SQZ fire tags appear in History from Monday Oct 12: History did not keep the moment a Skittles box or squeeze turned, so older days still miss those two (RVOL↑ / MOM↑ / arrows now show on old days too).

releases.heading: Bot: compare contracts and exits - next week vs same-day vs 0.20 delta, your exit vs hold to close vs best
items: New switches on the Bot page: Contract (Next week / Same-day / 0.20 delta) and Exit (Your exit / Hold to close / Best price). Every win, loss, P/L and ROI follows your choice, together with the Mid / Pro / Real fills switch.
New tab "Contract × exit": every rule scored all 9 ways side by side (wins-losses, win rate, ROI) - the best one per rule is highlighted.

At 3:50 PM the bot now prices EVERY trade's close from one live quote (all three contracts), and retries each minute until 4:28 PM if Schwab is slow. On Oct 9 no close was recorded for MRNA, so its same-day 200C (+934% held to the close) never showed up.
The same-day and 0.20-delta contracts are now followed all day, not just until your exit.
No guessing: a past day without a recorded close shows "-" for Hold to close; Best price is hindsight and shows on Mid fills only. Full close data starts Monday Oct 12.

releases.heading: Scanner board no longer waits on Schwab downloads
items: Each Watchlist build used to wait about a minute for its own Schwab downloads, while a background job was already downloading the same candles. Builds now use the candles already held and the background job keeps them fresh, so the board refreshes about a minute sooner each time.

releases.heading: Scanner records how long each part of a board build takes
items: Nothing changes on screen. The scanner now writes one line per board build saying how long each stage took, so the remaining slowness of the Watchlist board can be fixed from measurements instead of guesses.

releases.heading: Scanner stops re-reading the 17 MB stream file
items: When the scanner was busy, one slow check of the live candle feed made it re-read a 17 MB backup file every 30-60 seconds. It now keeps using the live feed unless it has been unreachable for 5 minutes, which frees time for building your board.

releases.heading: Watchlist scanner builds much faster
items: Over half of every Watchlist board build was spent re-reading every ticker's full candle history just to find the newest candle time. It now reads only the last candle, so the board refreshes far more often.

releases.heading: After a scanner restart, your Watchlist builds first
items: After a restart the scanner built every list at once, so the Watchlist waited 10 minutes behind the EMA Touch lists. Watchlist and Mag7 now build first; the other lists show their last board and catch up 5 minutes later (or right away if you open one).

releases.heading: Scanner: faster builds (News rule check)
items: Behind the scenes: the bot's News ▲/▼ check no longer slows every scanner build. It reuses the latest headlines for up to a minute instead of re-reading them each time, so the Watchlist board refreshes sooner.

releases.heading: Scanner spends less time converting Schwab candles
items: Converting each Schwab download into candles took about a tenth of the scanner's time. It is now about 15 times faster, with exactly the same candles, which leaves more time for building your Watchlist board.

releases.heading: Scanner: squeezes that build overnight now show (SQZ, Setup tags, bot)
items: The scanner reads Schwab's candles, and Schwab has no same-day candles before 7 AM (the overnight hours arrive a day later). A squeeze that built overnight - like MRNA's 2h today, ON from midnight and fired at 9 AM in TOS - was invisible to the scanner's SQZ column, the Setup column's SQZ tags and the bot's SQZ rule.
The scanner now fills ONLY that missing overnight window (8 PM yesterday to 4 AM today) from Alpaca's overnight feed, next to the existing 4-7 AM fill. Every candle Schwab has stays Schwab's.

releases.heading: Watchlist scanner refreshes on time again
items: The scanner was rebuilding five lists back-to-back (Watchlist, Mag7, Movers and the two EMA Touch lists), and they slowed each other down: at 2:28 PM a Watchlist rebuild took 11 minutes, so the board was 20 minutes old.
Watchlist and Mag7 still refresh continuously. Movers and the EMA Touch lists now refresh every 5 minutes unless you have them open, and opening one refreshes it right away.

releases.heading: Chart: 2h and 4h 🔥 squeeze fires show right away
items: The 🔥 2h (and 4h) squeeze fire needs about 2-5 days of candles. The chart's first load had only ~1.5 days, so on MRNA today the 🔥2h at 9:00 that TOS showed was missing until the full history loaded - or never, on a phone that did not finish it. The first load now includes two weeks of 5-minute candles, so the fires match TOS from the start.

releases.heading: MomX: grade letter no longer hidden by a flashing tag
items: In the Setup column, a flashing tag (like SKIT↑ 2h) could cover the grade letter next to it - MRNA showed only a sliver of its A. The flashing tag now keeps a little space on both sides.

releases.heading: Bot page: Pro fills view
items: Third Fills option on the Bot page: Pro (mid ±¼) - prices each trade like a limit order worked from the mid: bought at mid + ¼ of the spread, sold at mid - ¼. It sits between Mid (best case) and Real (market orders). Like Real, it starts with today's trades.

releases.heading: Bot page: Real fills (buy at the ask, sell at the bid)
items: New switch on the Bot page: Fills: Mid / Real (ask→bid). Real shows every number as if you bought at the ask and sold at the bid - what a market order actually pays on short-dated options. Mid is the old view.
The bot records bid and ask from today (Oct 9), so Real starts with today's trades and fills in day by day.

releases.heading: Woodies and Pivot Point levels are full lines across the chart
items: WoodiesPivots (Daily chart) and PivotPoints D P / W P / M P levels used to be a few-pixel stub at the right edge - only the current period's one or two candles, or the few bars since 4:00 AM overnight. Each level now runs across the whole chart, 2px thick, ending at its R1 / PP / S1 label, the same way the prior-day and OI levels do.

releases.heading: Bot page: new 'Daily line before 10:00' line
items: The Rule leaderboard now shows 'Daily line before 10:00' - the Daily line trades whose signal came before 10 AM. On puts it has won 70% (44 trades, Sep 28 - Oct 8); it is a view of the same trades, so the totals do not change. Watch whether it holds now that trades enter at the signal.
Behind the scenes: the bot saves its trade files at most every 10 seconds instead of after every ticker, so the scanner stays faster at the open and the close.

releases.heading: Bot: takes every signal 9:30-3:30, never on stale data
items: The bot no longer stops a rule at 150 trades a day. Before, MOM, RVOL, SKIT, MOM strong and FLIP hit that limit every day and later signals were skipped.

The bot only takes a signal when the ticker has a 5-minute candle from today. On a market holiday, or if the data feed is stale, it takes no trades - before, rules like Market turn, MX A+, Daily 2, ADX and the sector rules could have fired on the previous day's data.

releases.heading: Bot page loads again
items: The Bot page showed all zeros because its data request waited behind the busy scanner and gave up after 20 seconds. The page now reads the bot's trades directly and loads in a second or two.

releases.heading: The chart's A / A+ letters now have a name and an on/off box
items: The green A / A+ (below the candle, calls) and red (above, puts) letters are the MomX scanner's grade. They are now listed in Indicators & studies as "MomX Grade (A+/A)" with a checkbox - untick it to hide them; "Save ... for all tickers" remembers the choice per chart timeframe.

releases.heading: "Save D for all tickers" works on the phone and reaches every device
items: On the phone, "Save ... for all tickers" failed with "Unable to save D settings": the MomX scanner's offline copy of the boards had filled the phone's browser storage (4.6 MB of ~5 MB). The scanner copy is now kept small, and a settings save always wins - if storage is full it clears the scanner copy first.

Saved indicator settings are now also stored on the server under your account, so a save on the phone shows on the desktop and the other way round (the newest save wins when a chart opens). If the server can't be reached the message says "saved on this device only".

releases.heading: WoodiesPivots on the Daily chart; Friday daily candles fixed
items: New study WoodiesPivots (your TOS settings): time frame 4 DAYS, show only today - R3 / R2 / R1 / PP / S1 / S2 / S3 as dashed lines with dots and axis labels, on the Daily (D) chart only. The 4-day blocks are the same weekday blocks TOS uses (10/2-10/7, then 10/8-10/13). Time frame, show-only-today and colours are in the Indicators panel. R is TOS red (255, 95, 95); PP and S colours are placeholders until you send the PP / S1 colour tabs.

Fixed a mistake in the 10/3 daily-candle cleanup: a Friday's daily candle stamped 8 PM was thrown away and a tiny overnight stub took its place (SPY and AFRM 10/2 among others). Each candle now keeps its own date; each chart's daily candles come back complete on its next full refresh.

releases.heading: Bot: trades now enter at the signal
items: The bot now buys each paper option the moment its rule fires, at a live Schwab quote. Before, at the open it waited in a queue - on Oct 8 most trades were priced 40-75 minutes after the signal, so the scoreboard measured late entries.
If a ticker has no option chain on hand yet, its trade is still priced the old way, a little later.

releases.heading: Bot: new News ▲ / News ▼ rule (same tickers as the scanner)
items: The bot now takes a paper trade on every ticker the scanner lists under NEWS ▲ (calls, BULL) or NEWS ▼ (puts, BEAR) with Scan matches only ticked - a scan match whose news Jev reads as bullish / bearish. No ETFs, 9:30 AM-3:30 PM, one trade per ticker per day.
Bot page > News trade now shows exactly these trades. It starts today, so earlier days are empty.

releases.heading: MomX: NEWS ▲ / NEWS ▼ follow Scan matches only
items: With 'Scan matches only' ticked, NEWS ▲ (BULL) and NEWS ▼ (BEAR) now count and show only the scan matches with bullish / bearish news - the same tickers as the scanner. Untick it to see the whole list.

releases.heading: MomX: MOM tag now matches the bot
items: The Setup column's MOM↑ / MOM↓ tag now shows only when it comes from today's 5-minute candle, the same as the bot's MOM rule. Before, a ticker with no trading today could still show MOM from an older day (WBD showed one from Monday evening).

releases.heading: Bot page: new News trade view
items: Next to Jev BOT there is a new News trade button. On BULL it shows only the bot's call trades on tickers whose news Jev read as bullish when the bot entered; on BEAR, only the put trades on tickers with bearish news. Same scoreboard (P/L, win rate, ROI, best/worst rule) for just those trades. Jev started reading news Oct 1-2, so earlier days have none. Paper only - the bot still takes every trade.

releases.heading: Watchlist streams live from 7:00 AM, even with no scanner screen open
items: From 7:00 to 9:25 AM, your top Watchlist tickers now stay on the live Schwab stream whether or not a MomX screen is open. Before, they dropped off the stream when no screen was open (Oct 6: 145 tickers had no live candles from 8:03 to 9:25), so charts and the scanner fell back to slower downloads.
The lightning-bolt (live momentum) signals are unchanged: before 9:25 they still run only while a MomX screen is open.

releases.heading: MomX: news ▲/▼ load fast
items: The news ▲/▼ marks could take 6-35 seconds to appear because they waited behind the news collector saving headlines. They now load in well under a second. Live from 8:55 PM ET.

releases.heading: MomX: the news button is now called NEWS ▲ / NEWS ▼
items: The new button next to NEWS is renamed: NEWS ▲ on the BULL scanner (bullish news only) and NEWS ▼ on the BEAR scanner (bearish news only).

releases.heading: MomX: new ▲ BULLISH / ▼ BEARISH news button
items: Next to NEWS there is a new button. On the BULL scanner it says ▲ BULLISH and shows only the tickers whose news Jev reads as bullish; on the BEAR scanner it says ▼ BEARISH and shows only bearish news. The number on it is how many tickers that is. Press again for the whole board.
If the news ▲/▼ marks have not loaded yet, the page now asks again every 15 seconds instead of waiting 2 minutes.

releases.heading: MomX: News ▲/▼ no longer disappear when you come back
items: Leaving the MomX tab and coming back used to drop the Jev bullish ▲ / bearish ▼ marks in the News column for up to about 30 seconds. They now stay on screen while fresh news loads.

releases.heading: Better tracking of slow chart opens
items: Nothing changes on screen. Any chart that takes more than half a second to first appear is now recorded with where the time went, so the occasional 0.6-0.9 second open can be traced.

releases.heading: Bot page: Jev buttons only on Jev BOT
items: The Jev 10% / 20% / 30% buttons now show only when Jev BOT is picked. All trades no longer shows them.

releases.heading: Better tracking of slow charts
items: Nothing changes on screen. The app now records the time of every background chart refresh and every slow chart open, so tomorrow's market open can show exactly which refreshes slow the charts down.

releases.heading: Opening a chart no longer slows the other charts
items: Sending a full chart (4-6 MB) used to briefly lock up the app for everyone else, so another chart opening at the same moment could wait a second or two. The chart is now prepared in small steps. Same chart data.

releases.heading: Fewer short chart pauses
items: The app was re-reading the whole MomX Watchlist board (about 3 MB) every few seconds, and each read briefly held up chart opens. It now reads the board only when the scanner actually writes a new one. Same tickers, same option watchlist.

releases.heading: Charts no longer pause while another chart is being saved
items: When the app saved a freshly updated chart to disk it briefly locked up every other chart request (a chart opened at that moment took 1-2 seconds). Saving now happens in small steps and only once instead of twice, so chart opens are not held up. The saved charts are exactly the same.

releases.heading: Less background work saving live candles
items: The live-candle save every 30 seconds now only re-processes the tickers that actually traded since the last save, instead of all ~500. That frees the app for chart opens, especially outside busy hours. Same saved data.

releases.heading: Fixes multi-second freezes when opening charts
items: This morning's change to how the app saves its live-candle history made it freeze everything for about 6 seconds every 30 seconds, so a chart open could take 5-10 seconds. The save now works in small pieces and never freezes the app for more than a fraction of a second. Same saved data.

releases.heading: Signal labels recalculate in half the time
items: The 30m/1H/2H/4H label calculation that runs on every chart update now takes about half as long (NVDA: 0.34-0.44 s, was 0.67-0.86 s), so charts should keep closer to the live price during busy periods like the open. The labels are exactly the same - checked on five charts before and after.

releases.heading: Chart updates take less work
items: Each chart update recalculates the 30m/1H/2H/4H signal labels. One step of that (working out which day each signal falls on) is now about a third cheaper. The labels themselves are exactly the same - checked on NVDA, SPY, TSLA, AAPL and AMD before and after.

releases.heading: Slow chart opens now explain themselves
items: Behind the scenes: any chart open that takes over 2 seconds is now logged with where the time went (sign-in check, building the chart, or sending it), so the next slow open can be fixed from facts instead of guesses. Nothing changes on screen.

releases.heading: No more random multi-second pauses opening a chart
items: Every request re-checked your sign-in against the database every 15 seconds, and when the database was busy that check made a chart open wait 2-9 seconds. The app now keeps using your sign-in while it re-checks in the background. Signing out or disabling an account still takes effect immediately.

releases.heading: Fewer brief chart-open stalls
items: Every 30 seconds the app saved its live-candle history in a slow way that briefly held up chart opens (some took 1-2.5 seconds). It now saves the same data about three times faster, so those stalls are shorter and rarer.

releases.heading: The last premarket minutes before 7 AM fill in
items: The candles from about 6:52 to 6:59 AM stayed blank all day, because the app stopped asking the delayed premarket feed at 7:10, before that feed had caught up. It now keeps asking until 7:25, so the whole 4-7 AM premarket shows.

releases.heading: Overnight and premarket candles no longer vanish from a chart
items: A quick chart refresh could wipe the overnight and premarket candles (8 PM-7 AM) off a chart, because Schwab, the source of that refresh, has none for those hours. SPY lost all of this morning's candles before 7 AM this way. A refresh now only adds or updates candles and never removes ones it does not have.

releases.heading: Overnight D-M signals stay on scanner tickers' charts
items: Follow-up to the smaller scanner-ticker charts: a D-M signal from the overnight session (for example a 1 AM CALLM) is always kept, so it still shows on the day's first candle, matching the scanner.

releases.heading: Scanner tickers' charts download a quarter of the data
items: Opening a chart for one of the premarket scanner's tickers (NVDA, TSLA and the others) sent about 2 MB, three-quarters of it D-M signals going back to 2006 that the chart cannot show. It now sends only the signals on the visible candles, about 0.5 MB, so these charts load faster on the phone. The D-M signals you see are unchanged.

releases.heading: First open of a chart is quicker when the app is busy
items: Opening a chart for the first time since the app started took 2-2.5 seconds while the app was busy (SNOW, HOOD, HIMS, MU, SMCI). Its saved copy now loads several times faster under load.

releases.heading: A chart you have not opened in a while appears at once
items: Some charts saved days ago held signal labels from an older version. Opening one first recalculated those labels while you waited (CRWD took 11 seconds this morning). The candles now show straight away and the current labels fill in a few seconds later.

releases.heading: Charts open quicker before and during the session
items: Once a minute the app was recalculating two old Mag7 signal tables that no screen shows any more. Chart opens that landed on that work took 1.3-1.9 seconds instead of a few tenths. The app no longer recalculates them; your charts' own signals are unchanged.

releases.heading: News list stays quick through its 2-minute refresh
items: Each 2-minute background news refresh made the next news list load wait several seconds. It now keeps showing the current headlines while the new ones load; pressing refresh still shows the newest at once.

releases.heading: News list never waits on a refresh
items: Follow-up to the news list fix: when its shared headlines were due for a refresh, one request still waited 25-30 seconds. It now shows the headlines it already has and refreshes them in the background.

releases.heading: The news list loads in about a second again
items: The main news list could take 10 seconds to over a minute, and while it waited it also held up the dashboard and position updates behind it. Its headlines are now shared between screens for 30 seconds, and a finished news refresh still shows straight away.

releases.heading: Charts no longer freeze for 20-30 seconds on some opens
items: Found the cause of the rare 20-30 second chart opens today (AAPL, NVDA): a quick candle top-up saved the chart marked 'signals still being worked out', so the next time that ticker was opened the server re-did all the 2H/4H signal work before showing anything. The top-up now keeps the signals' status, so those opens are back to about a second.

releases.heading: Scanner keeps its candles when the PC wakes from sleep
items: After the PC slept from about 2:51 to 7:10 PM, the scanner had dropped the candles for 359 of its 369 tickers and showed them as "queued" while it reloaded (about 10 minutes). It no longer drops tickers because the PC was asleep, and its saved copy can no longer be overwritten by a much smaller one.

releases.heading: Finer timing for slow chart opens
items: Behind the scenes only: the slow-chart log now splits the step that took 28 seconds on AAPL tonight into its parts, so the fix can target the exact one. Nothing changes on screen.

releases.heading: Slow chart opens now log which step was slow
items: Behind the scenes only: three chart opens today took 6 to 30 seconds on the server (AAPL, TSLA, NVDA) and could not be caught in the act. The server now writes down how long each step of a slow chart open took, so the next one shows exactly what to fix. Nothing changes on screen.

releases.heading: News, dashboard and health stop freezing when MomX is open
items: Every MomX screen asked the server for its News column every 15 seconds, and each ask waited in one line for the database. At the open that line grew to 52 requests: the main news list hung for over a minute and the dashboard took 7 seconds. The News column answer is now shared for 15 seconds between screens showing the same tickers, and a finished news refresh still shows at once.

releases.heading: Chart timing reports note when the window was in the background
items: Behind the scenes only: the chart speed reports now record whether the app was in the background while a chart drew, so a slow draw on a hidden window is not mistaken for a slow chart. Nothing changes on screen.

releases.heading: Tickers off your board catch up right away
items: Opening a ticker that is not on your board (a scanner pick like AAOI or COHR) could show candles from an hour or more ago until the chart forced a slow refresh, because its update waited in line behind the board tickers. Now a chart that is more than 3 minutes behind starts its own quick catch-up the moment you open it; the new candles arrive a few seconds later without slowing the open.

releases.heading: Premarket charts stay current again
items: Before the open, some charts (COHR, LASR) were stuck on 5-6 AM candles while those stocks kept trading, and only caught up after a slow refresh when you opened them. Stock charts now refresh every few minutes before the open. Index charts like SPX, which cannot trade before 9:30, are unchanged.

releases.heading: Reopening the app no longer stalls the chart
items: The second half of the reopen fix: after the quick candle top-up the server re-worked the 2H/4H signal labels before answering, which still held a chart 7-16 seconds. It now answers right away; your labels stay on screen and the updated ones arrive with the next refresh a few seconds later.

releases.heading: Charts come back fast when you reopen the app
items: When you came back to the app after the phone slept, an open chart asked the server for its newest candles and waited for them - 11 to 25 seconds this morning while the premarket was busy. It now waits at most 2.5 seconds: you see the chart right away and the newest candles land a few seconds later on their own.

releases.heading: SPX stops re-downloading while it is not trading
items: SPX only trades 9:30 AM-4:00 PM ET, but before the open the app still asked Schwab for new SPX candles every 30 seconds and got none. Each ask took 4-18 seconds of server time, and an SPX chart refresh waited on it. Outside trading hours SPX is now left as it is once it is up to date; it refreshes normally again from 9:30 AM. Stocks are unchanged and keep updating premarket.

releases.heading: Charts fast again: SPX was rebuilding nonstop
items: SPX (an index - no premarket or overnight candles) was rebuilt on every request: 666 times in 9 minutes. That kept both chart workers busy, so every other chart and the news list waited. A quick refresh that finds no newer candles now counts as up to date; SPX still refreshes every 30 seconds and updates normally once it trades.

releases.heading: App opens faster: the news list no longer makes you wait
items: Opening the app asked the server for the news list, and the server re-collected news from 10 sources while you waited - measured 75 seconds for one request, holding a connection your chart needed. It now answers instantly from the stored headlines and refreshes in the background.

releases.heading: Charts retry a dropped download instead of 'Load failed'
items: A chart download that drops on the phone (Safari's 'Load failed', or a chart showing only the live price line) is retried automatically after 1.5 s and 4 s, the same way the MomX board already does.
The app now records how long each chart takes to load on YOUR device (request, download, drawn) so slow loads can be measured instead of guessed.

releases.heading: Jev: every score records which Jev model answered
items: Scanner Jev scores and BOT Jev answers now save the model version (today jev-1.13.0). The 10% / 30% cut-offs were measured on one model; if TypeSafe upgrades it, results can be split by version instead of mixed.

releases.heading: Premarket table: the News cell shows a story about the company
items: A headline that names the company now beats a tagged story about another company - on Fri Oct 2 META's row showed an Apple story and MSFT's a Google one.
When the only story found does not name the company it is kept but marked RELATED.

releases.heading: Premarket page checked: 4-7 AM data, briefing wording, phone layout
items: The Alpaca key saved in Settings is refused by Alpaca (401). The 4:00-7:00 AM premarket fill, the overnight candles and the backup feed used ONLY that key, so they were getting nothing. The app now tests each Alpaca key and uses the first one that works (your new paper5 key).
Morning briefing: after 9:30 the first line now says 'at 9:31 AM (after the open)' instead of 'premarket' - Friday's briefing showed 9:31 prices (MSTU +10.9%) as premarket (it was +6.9% at 9:29).

Morning briefing: a news headline that does not name the company is marked 'related news', and 'signals and news agree' is only said when the story is about that stock (Friday's META 'catalyst' was a general AI-trading survey).

Phone: the Premarket Scanner card and the History day picker / archived briefing fit the screen - the briefing's date and 'Oct 2, 2026' were off the right edge, so an old briefing looked like today's.

releases.heading: SPX (and NDX, RUT, VIX, XSP, DJX, OEX) charts and options work
items: Type SPX on the chart: candles, studies, the live price and the option chain now load. Schwab only answers an index by its $ name ($SPX); the app now translates it for you.

SPX open interest comes from CBOE (the exchange that lists SPX): Schwab sends 0 for every SPX option, so the High-OI walls were empty. The OI updates once a day; the app checks CBOE at most once an hour.
Alpaca has no index data, so SPX is not in the MomX scanner's numbers.

releases.heading: EMA touch lists: timeframe dropdown on its own row
items: The Monthly / Weekly / Daily dropdown now sits on its own line ('EMA chart:') under the list name, so on a phone the name still shows 21 or 50 instead of being cut to '21 ...'.

releases.heading: EMA touch lists: Monthly / Weekly / Daily dropdown
items: On the 21 and 50 EMA touch lists a new dropdown next to the list name picks the chart the touch is measured on: Monthly (default), Weekly or Daily.
The list name follows it ('21 EMA Touch Weekly'), and each timeframe keeps its own History.
Weekly and Daily use the last week / last session, so they still show tickers after the close and at the weekend.
Note: in the back-test only the Monthly touch beat buying on any day; Weekly and Daily were no better.

releases.heading: Friday report: does a high Jev score help the monthly EMA touch LEAPs?
items: Every Friday the 4 PM scorecard adds a 'Jev x EMA touch' section for the 21 / 50 EMA Touch Monthly lists.
It compares tickers that had a Jev score of 10% or more against the rest: the stock move and a modelled 1-year call (10% in the money and 20% out of the money) after 5, 10, 21 and 63 trading days.
It will say 'too few to judge' until each group has 30 finished trades - expect that for several weeks.

releases.heading: Card chart on History snapshots; far OI walls labelled at the edge
items: A card opened from History now shows that day's 4:00-20:00 chart, with a dotted yellow line at the snapshot's moment (a weekend snapshot shows the last trading day).
An OI wall outside the chart's price range is labelled at the top or bottom edge (e.g. '↑ 35C 75') instead of disappearing - thin names like ARQQ only have one or two strikes with any open interest.

releases.heading: MomX: two new lists - 21 EMA Touch Monthly and 50 EMA Touch Monthly
items: The Watchlist dropdown has two new built-in lists: '21 EMA Touch Monthly' and '50 EMA Touch Monthly'.
Each one holds the Watchlist (371) tickers whose price touched that monthly EMA this month while in an uptrend (last month closed above a rising EMA) - the LEAP entry we back-tested.
The same Bull Momo scan runs on them: same 'all of' rules plus the EMA touch, same 'any of' rules as Watchlist. Matches rank first, as on every list.
The lists fill themselves and update every 10 minutes; a ticker joins when it touches and a new month starts empty. You cannot add or remove tickers by hand on them.
Watchlist 371, its columns and your other lists are unchanged.

releases.heading: Ticker card: fired time like MomoX
items: Under the fired signals the card now says when the newest one fired, e.g. 'fired 0 min ago on the weekly · 10:25 AM ET'.
The time is when our scanner first saw that signal. It is kept through restarts, and a signal that stops and fires again gets a new time.
Existing signals get their first time on the first scan after this update, so today's first readings show the update time.

releases.heading: Alpaca option bot: two Jev books from the MomX scanner; card chart shows more OI levels
items: paper5 'Watchlist option' takes positions only on MomX Watchlist board MATCHES that Jev approves (take chance 10% or more, score under 30 minutes old).
paper3 'Mag7 OPTION' does the same for the MomX Mag7 board's matches.
No ETFs, and if the scanner board is more than 30 minutes old the bot gets no tickers.
Ticker card chart: draws the OI levels around the price - the same 8-a-side rule as the OI page's High-OI board - not just the card's top 3.

releases.heading: Ticker card looks like MomoX: today's chart with the OI walls
items: New 'today 4:00-20:00 ET' chart on the ticker card: the day's price line (premarket and after-hours shaded) with the High-OI walls from our OI page drawn as dashed lines (strike + OI) and the ±EM2 edges.
The fired line shows only the signals that fired (e.g. '⚡ 9x20 2h · MACD 4h · MACD D') - no more 'BLOCKED pricechange...' codes.
RVOL boxes on the card print their number even when not lit (dim grey), like MomoX. The scanner board still hides them, as TOS does.
Expected move and walls stay from our own OI page.

releases.heading: Scanner News column shows the story ABOUT the company
items: A headline that names the company now beats a newer story that only carries the ticker tag. On Fri Oct 2 NBIS showed a CoreWeave price-target story and a day-old Burry story while real Nebius news existed.
The column now also reads the app's own 8-source news store, so a company story no longer vanishes from the cell (NBIS went blank at 09:53).
Ticker round-ups like 'ADPT, MRNA, CRWV, NBIS, JAZZ trending with analysts' no longer count as a company story.
Jev reads the same headline, so its news reading now sees the right story.

releases.heading: Option auto-bot (Alpaca paper) now uses your MomX scanner matches
items: New choice 'MomX scanner (BULL board)' in Option Bot Watchlist, and it is now selected: the bot looks only at the MATCHES you see on the MomX Watchlist board with 'Scan matches only' ticked - the same list you trade by hand. No Jev filter, ETFs skipped.
If the scanner board is more than 30 minutes old the bot gets no tickers, so it can never trade an old list.
The MomX BOT on the Bot page is unchanged. The Alpaca auto-bot still cannot place paper orders until a new Alpaca paper key is entered.

releases.heading: BOT: 2x expected move / +100% ROI check on every trade (still takes every trade)
items: Every BOT trade is now checked against your rule: would the option be worth at least double (+100%) if the stock reached 2x the expected move from the entry price? The bot still takes every trade.
Jev reads this risk/reward line before giving its take chance, so it can weigh it.
Bot page: each trade shows ✓ 2×EM or ✗ 2×EM, and the '✓ Jev + 2×EM' tab compares the two groups per rule - older trades are checked too.
Ticker card, Market Structure pillar: now prices the same contract the bot buys and passes only at +100% or more at 2x the expected move.
First look at Sep 28 - Oct 2 (prices partly stale): trades passing the rule won more often but lost half or more MORE often - it favours cheap far-out options. Judged nightly from Monday.

releases.heading: Option bot: takes 2H/4H CALL setups; scan renamed 'Mag7 + Watchlist Options'
items: The option auto-bot now accepts the scanner's 2H/4H CALL arrow setup (MTF EMA C/CALL 2H/4H) when all its conditions are green - it was never on the bot's allowed list, so those could not be taken.
The option scan is now called 'Mag7 + Watchlist Options' everywhere, the same as the account card (was 'MAG7-Watchlist Options').
Every automatic test now passes (3,488 backend + 1,477 screen). Some tests had been reading LIVE Schwab prices instead of their own example data; none of this changes how the app trades.

releases.heading: Five Pillars now match the full MomoX3 graphic
items: 03 Market structure: shows the option's delta and an estimated ROI - the ~0.30-delta contract at its ask, valued if the stock reaches the expected-move edge. If that option cannot pay even at the edge, the pillar fails.
04 Sell targets: now also pivot points (PP / R1 / R2 / S1 / S2), the 21 / 50 EMAs on 5m and 30m, and Fibonacci levels of today's range.

Round-number targets now step with the price ($1 under $25, $5 under $250, $10 under $1000) - the next whole dollar on a $150 stock was only 0.7% away and failed the target pillar on almost every ticker.
05 Buy signals: the 4x8 EMA cross (early trend) now counts - live after the scanner worker restarts.
Not included because we do not compute them: Ichimoku Span B and supply/demand zones. The 'low squeeze' level is also missing - our TOS squeeze feed has only high and mid.

releases.heading: Five Pillars card rebuilt to the MomoX definitions - calls and puts
items: 01 Trend: EMA 9/21/50 on 5m and 30m plus the higher-timeframe trend (Skittles 2h / 4h / D / W) - 'N of M with the call/put' - and where price sits in today's range (Fibonacci retracement).
02 Price action: squeeze contraction (high / mid) vs expansion (fired) on 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, D and W.
03 Market structure: the critical time of day, the stock's strength or weakness today, its sector, and the expected move left.
04 Sell targets: the next levels in the trade's direction - OI walls, prior-day high / low, premarket high, whole-number and 5% psych levels.
05 Buy signals: crosses, chart arrows, squeeze fired, stochastics, RVOL - and how many are stacked.
A put ticker is now graded with the put logic (below the EMAs, magenta fires, put walls and levels below).

releases.heading: Bot: calls and puts share one option-chain read
items: Behind the scenes: when the call bot and the put bot price the same ticker within a minute they now share one fresh option-chain read instead of reading it twice - fewer Schwab chain reads at the open, so new bot trades get priced sooner. Old saved copies are never shared.

releases.heading: Jev BOT trades from Jev score 10%+
items: The bot's 'Jev pick' rule now buys (paper) whenever a scanner ticker's Jev score is 10% or more - far more trades to learn from. Each trade keeps its score, so the Bot page's Jev ≥10% / ≥20% / ≥30% buttons show which level actually does best. The Bot page now opens at ≥10%. Up to 250 Jev pick trades a day.
Unchanged: the scanner's green ✓ and the '✓ JEV' Setup tag still mean 30%+ (Jev's strongest picks).

releases.heading: Daily check: do Jev's scanner picks beat its skips?
items: New in the 5 PM scorecard from Monday: a JEV SCANNER section. For every scanner ticker Jev scored, it measures what the stock did in the next hour and to the close, grouped Jev take (30%+), 20-30% and skip - with a 'mirror' column so a group that only picks jumpy stocks (big moves both ways) cannot look good. Calls and puts separately, plus running totals.

releases.heading: Saved charts keep one daily candle per day
items: Every time a chart is saved on the server its daily candles are cleaned to one per trading day, so the copies the app loads instantly are clean too. A candle dated on a weekend is kept; only a Friday-evening stub is dropped.

releases.heading: ADXClouds axis numbers no longer overlap
items: The ADXClouds pane axis stays 100% / 75% / 50% / 25% / 0% wherever you scroll (it used to shrink to 0-50% when you panned back, and the 100% / 75% labels fell off).

The Strong 25 / Weak 20 / ADX value bubbles that printed a second '25%' and '20.10%' over the axis are now really off in saved layouts too (the first switch didn't reach saved settings). Turn any back on with the ADX plot checkboxes.
Server: daily candles saved on disk before today are cleaned to one per day when they are read.

releases.heading: ADXClouds pane axis reads 100% / 75% / 50% / 25% / 0% like TOS
items: The ADXClouds + SqueezeChain24 pane under the chart now labels its right axis 100%, 75%, 50%, 25%, 0% - the same fixed steps as TOS - instead of a couple of odd values.

The extra value bubbles TOS does not show there (Strong 25, Weak 20, the ADX lines, and the SqueezeChain24 reading) are gone from the axis; the SqueezeChain24 value now sits in the pane title next to its name, the way TOS prints it. Signal bubbles stay, and the ADX plot checkboxes still let you turn any bubble back on.

releases.heading: FLIP↑ / FLIP↓: the early momentum flip, on the scanner and the BOT
items: Setup column: a dashed FLIP↓ (puts, magenta) shows when, on the last CLOSED 5-minute candle, the ADX background flips cyan -> magenta (sellers' line crosses above buyers') while the momentum dots are falling. FLIP↑ (calls, cyan) is the mirror. It comes before MOM, which waits for the dots to cross 0 - on APLD 10/2 the flip was the 10:50 candle, MOM not until 11:05.

BOT: new TEST rule "FLIP↑ / FLIP↓", first flip per stock per day, 09:30-15:30. Back-test Sep 1-28 on all optionable stocks: the flip did the SAME as random stocks at the same moment (calls and puts, both halves of the month) and fires on ~350 stocks a day - so treat it as a paper test, not an edge yet.

releases.heading: MTF Squeeze 410 now looks and reads like TOS; daily candles no longer doubled
items: shared_MTF_Squeeze410 (the gold squeeze pane under the chart) is drawn the TOS way: each timeframe row is a solid stripe stacked under the next, 5M on top, with the same see-through shading - the colours now measure identical to your TOS screenshot. 'Squeeze mid' uses TOS orange (golden, 255/200/0) instead of a redder orange.

Fixed a data bug that affected every ticker: the daily candles behind D / W studies held the same day 2-3 times (Schwab's daily candle plus copies built from intraday data - NVDA back to Aug 20). On CRDO that turned the Squeeze 410 'D' label orange while TOS shows it dark; with one candle per day it now matches TOS. Daily pivots, daily squeeze, daily ADX and other D/W studies all read the cleaned candles.

releases.heading: Chart News panel shows Jev's Bullish / Bearish
items: The NEWS panel on the right side of the chart now shows Jev's reading next to each headline: green 'Jev: Bullish 96%', red 'Jev: Bearish', grey 'Jev: Not important'. It uses the labels Jev already gave those headlines - no extra cost.

releases.heading: MOM tag turns solid cyan on a strong call setup (scanner + BOT)
items: Setup column: the MOM↑ tag now fills SOLID CYAN when it is a strong call setup - the momentum dots are cyan and rising AND the ADX background is filled cyan on BOTH 5m and 30m (DI+ above 25 and above DI-): buyers pushing harder, trend strong across timeframes. A plain MOM↑ stays outlined. Bear board: MOM↓ fills solid MAGENTA on the mirror setup. Hover the tag to see which it is.
BOT: a new test rule "MOM↑ strong" (puts: "MOM↓ strong") trades only that strong setup, so you can compare it with the plain MOM rule. It starts collecting trades Monday 10/05 - not back-tested yet.

releases.heading: Jev now sees OI walls, pivots and the PUT/CALL arrows
items: Jev's read of each ticker now also includes: daily pivots (P, R1, R2, S1, S2 from yesterday's high/low/close), the premarket high, the High-OI call and put walls and the 1-day expected move from the option chain (on bot trades, where the chain is read), the 5m and 30m EMA ribbons, the last 5-minute MACD cross, the stochastic, and the other side's chart arrows (PUT2H/PUT4H on a call ticker, CALL arrows on a put ticker).

releases.heading: ADX clouds (lower pane) now draw every cloud your TOS script draws
items: shared_MTF_ADXClouds_v225 was missing three of its eight cloud types: the white ADX cloud above 25, the cyan/magenta ADX clouds while DI+ or DI- is above 25, and the plum/dark-green clouds when DI+ or DI- drops under 20. All are drawn now, for every timeframe you have on (15m, 30m, 1h, 2h; 4h off like your TOS).

releases.heading: Jev checks your 4-point list on every ticker
items: Jev now reads your own quality list for each scanner ticker and bot trade, each check marked met or not met: 1) fresh news, 2) RVOL 5+ on 5m/15m or 3+ on 30m/1h/2h/4h/D, 3) squeeze firing on 2h/4h/D/W, 4) EMA 4/8, 9/20 + MACD cyan/green (Skittles) on 2h-M. Tested on a month of scanner history: all 4 met makes a 2% move about 3 times more likely, but up and down about equally - so Jev still has to judge the direction.

releases.heading: SqueezeChain line now fills the lower pane like TOS
items: The shared_SqueezeChain24 momentum line was squeezed into the bottom third of the lower pane, under the yellow ADX line. It now uses the full pane height like TOS, and always shows its dots (TOS LINE_VS_POINTS). Values and colours were already the same as TOS (CRDO today: cyan up to 10:15, purple falling to 11:15, magenta to 12:00).

releases.heading: Open-lag fix covers 5-minute and 30-minute data separately
items: Follow-up to the open-lag fix: a ticker whose 30-minute data is kept fresh by the live stream but whose 5-minute data is not is now refreshed on the normal turn for its 5-minute data (and the other way round), so its 5-minute RVOL and price cannot sit stale either.

releases.heading: Scanner: no more 30-minute-old rows at the open
items: Fixed: some tickers on the live stream kept stale data at the open - APLD and CRDO on Oct 2 still showed 09:05-09:10 volume and an old price at 09:44 while they were already up 7% (the real numbers reached the scanner at 09:47). A streamed ticker was pushed to the back of the refresh line for 30 minutes even when the stream was not actually updating it. Now it is pushed back only if the stream really updated it in the last 10 minutes; otherwise it is refreshed in the normal turn (a few minutes).

releases.heading: History now keeps the 1D chart and Quote on every row
items: In History, the 1D mini chart and the Quote column only showed on a ticker's first row of the day and were blank on every row after it. From now on every History row saves and shows them, like the live board.
Rows saved before tonight stay blank in those two columns: that part was never saved, so it cannot be brought back. The Jev column fills in History from now on too (Jev scores started this evening).

releases.heading: Jev no longer scores from out-of-date scanner rows
items: At the open some scanner rows lag (APLD 10-02 09:44 still showed 09:05-09:10 volume and an old price; the real +7% / RVOL 4.9 reached it at 09:47:30). Jev now waits for a fresh row before scoring a ticker, and a bot trade read from an old row tells Jev how old the volume bars are.

releases.heading: History ticker search finds the ticker again
items: Typing a ticker in History (for example APLD) with 'all days' showed nothing, even when that ticker was right there on the page. The search was giving up after 20 seconds while it read the whole 30-day archive.
It now answers in about a second, and a second search for the same ticker is instant. Nothing was lost: every scan since the morning was saved all along; only the search could not reach it.

releases.heading: Charts finish loading about 3 times faster after switching ticker
items: Switching ticker (MSTR to COHR) used to keep the page busy for about 9 seconds while the chart finished drawing. It now takes about 3 seconds.

The slow parts were the weekly/monthly pivot study and the A+/A grade circles redoing the same date math thousands of times. The pivot levels and circles are exactly the same as before; only the work to compute them is gone.

releases.heading: Jev now reads the Setup column too
items: Jev's score for each scanner ticker (and for each bot trade) now also uses the Setup column's signals that fired today - grade, GO, MX A+, Market turn, SOLO, LINE / $LINE / ZS / ABVX / RECLAIM, CALL2H / C2H chart arrows, MOM↑, V2 / V3 / Daily 2 - as your own signals, on top of RVOL, Skittles, squeeze, VWAP, sector, SPY and news.

releases.heading: BOT: Jev cut-off picker (10 / 20 / 30%) and clearer trade count
items: New 'Jev ≥10% / ≥20% / ≥30%' buttons on the Bot page: choose how high Jev's take chance must be for a trade to count as a Jev take - in Jev BOT, the ✓ Jev check and the ✓ marks. Lower = more trades. Sep 28 - Oct 2 calls (real prices): ≥10% 93 trades a day, 58% won, ROI +15%; ≥20% 38 a day, 65%, +14%; ≥30% 15 a day, 68%, +9%; no Jev 51%, +6%. 30% was fixed before the test; compare the others live before trusting one.
The Trades tile now says how many trades were priced and how many were 'bad quote' (not counted), so the wins and losses add up.

releases.heading: Jev reads the scanner picture in the right order
items: Small fix: for scanner tickers, the 'how to read RVOL' explanation now sits right after the RVOL numbers in what Jev reads (it was printed before the price).

releases.heading: Jev column fills in after hours too
items: The Jev column now shows a score at any hour, including evenings and weekends: Jev reads the latest scanner picture of each match (hover shows the time it read it). Outside market hours a ticker is re-read only when its picture changes. The Jev pick bot trades still happen only 09:30-15:30.

releases.heading: Jev column: clearer empty cell
items: An empty Jev cell (–) now says why when you hover: Jev reads scanner matches from 09:30 to 15:30 ET.

releases.heading: Scanner: new 'Jev' score column + bot 'Jev pick' rule
items: New 'Jev' column next to News: TypeSafe Jev reads every ticker on the scanner (its RVOL, Skittles, squeeze, momentum, VWAP, sector, SPY and news) and gives a take chance. 30% or more shows green with ✓ (take); below that is grey (skip). Hover for the time Jev read it. A ticker is re-read when its picture changes, at most every 10 minutes.

New BOT rule 'Jev pick' (test, paper): when a scanner ticker gets a Jev take (30%+), the bot buys the nearest weekly option like its other rules, so Jev's picks get their own win/loss and ROI on the Bot page.
Starts Monday 09:30. Sample from tonight: LASR ✓ 40% (clean breakout, volume lit 15m-4h), ARQQ 8% (breakout failed), ZM 1% (down on the day, weak volume).

releases.heading: Jev now reads your rule definitions; '✓ JEV' on the scanner
items: When the BOT buys a trade, Jev is now told what that rule means in your own words (the same text as Bot > Rules explained), what our RVOL numbers mean, and the full headline - so it judges the setup the way you defined it. On TSLA 10-02 Jev misread RVOL 6.0 as weak volume and saw only the production miss in a cut-off headline.

New Setup tag '✓ JEV 09:44' on the scanner: the BOT took a trade on that ticker today and Jev said TAKE (take chance 30%+). Hover shows the rule and Jev's %. Paper / test only - Bot > Jev BOT keeps its score.
Starts Monday. The new wording is judged only on days it runs live (each trade records which version Jev saw).

releases.heading: BOT fix: no more fake option prices
items: Found and fixed: the BOT sometimes 'bought' options at prices from an old saved copy of the option chain (up to hours old). Example: APLD 24.5 call 'bought' at $0.25 at 09:32 while the stock was $25.90 - that call was worth at least $1.40, so the +552% was not a real trade.

523 of 8,694 bot trades (Sep 28 - Oct 2) had such impossible prices, and they made most of the recorded profit. They now show as 'bad quote' and count nowhere - wins, ROI and P/L on the BOT page are now from real prices only, so every rule's numbers dropped.
From now on the BOT only buys from an option chain Schwab read in the last 3 minutes whose stock price matches the scanner's live price; otherwise it waits and tries again.

releases.heading: BOT: 'Jev BOT' switch
items: New switch at the top of the BOT page: All trades | Jev BOT. Jev BOT counts ONLY the trades TypeSafe Jev would take - P/L, ROI, win rate, leaderboard, trades, periods and day by day all change to Jev's picks. Paper only; the bot still takes every trade.
Sep 28 - Oct 2 use the back-test's Jev marks; live marks start Monday Oct 5. Flip between the two to compare.

releases.heading: BOT: '✓ Jev' test - Jev reads every bot trade
items: From Monday, every virtual BOT trade is also read by TypeSafe Jev the moment the option is bought. The BOT still takes EVERY trade - Jev never buys, skips or changes anything.

New BOT tab '✓ Jev (test)': per rule, wins/losses, average % and ROI for All trades vs the trades Jev would take (its take chance 30% or more) vs the ones it would skip. Trades Jev would take also show a green '✓ Jev' in the Trades list.

Why a test: the Sep 28 - Oct 2 back-test (4,634 bot trades) found Jev's picks on calls won 63% vs 55% for all trades, but the same +29% average at your exit, and on puts it said yes only 10 times. Not proven - about 3 weeks of live results will decide.

releases.heading: News back to fast; Jev's word on the ticker card
items: Fixed: news went blank (no headlines, no Jev ▲/▼) this evening. The new CNBC/MarketWatch/Investing.com matcher re-read every headline once per ticker and kept the server busy; it now reads each headline once - 400 headlines take 0.1 s instead of 61 s, same matches.
The ticker card now shows Jev's reading of the headline too (Bullish / Bearish / Not important), not just the headline.

releases.heading: News filters tightened after the first live check
items: Law-firm lawsuit ads ('INVESTOR ALERT: ... Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses') that came in through Google News are now dropped from every source we match by name.
