Company names that are ordinary words - Booking, Carnival, Celsius, Microchip, Upstart, Snowflake and a few more - now need company words next to them, so 'From Booking to Follow-Through ...' is no longer filed under BKNG.
Micron and SanDisk news is no longer filed under the DRAM fund.

releases.heading: News: Google News, CNBC, MarketWatch and Investing.com added
items: Google News is now read for each ticker, but only stories from known publishers (Reuters, CNBC, Barron's, TipRanks, Investing.com, ...) whose HEADLINE names the company. Tested first: it found stories none of our other sources had, like 'JPMorgan cuts Sigma Lithium stock rating' and 'Ouster soars as new drone deal ignites investor hopes'.
CNBC, MarketWatch and Investing.com are checked every 2 minutes; a story is filed under a ticker only when its headline names that company.

Kept out on purpose: quote and chart pages, option-contract pages, 'biggest movers' round-ups, newsletters, stories older than 3 days, and Investing.com's automatic 'earnings beat/missed by $0.0x' pages (they restate an old quarter under today's date).

Company names that are ordinary words (Target, Apple, Intel, Quantum, Strategy) count only with company words next to them - 'Target CEO', 'Apple's', 'Intel shares' - so 'price target' is not Target and 'quantum computing' is not Quantum Corp.
The HEADLINES line now counts 4 live feeds.

releases.heading: News: Seeking Alpha added as a 9th source
items: MomX news now also reads Seeking Alpha for each ticker. Checked first on 40 board tickers: 22 of its 35 stories in 48 hours were in none of our other sources - for example 'Brazil regulator orders shutdown of part of Sigma Lithium's mine' (SGML).
Seeking Alpha round-ups that tag many tickers at once ('Most and least shorted ... stocks') are skipped.
Google News was tested too and NOT added: most of its 'new' results were quote pages, option pages and stories about other companies.

releases.heading: Charts no longer wait behind the premarket table after 10 AM
items: After 10:00 ET the premarket scanner table cannot change, but every open app still rebuilt it (6.4 seconds of server time each, a third of the server in the measurement), which made chart loads wait. It is now rebuilt at most once every 5 minutes outside its 06:00-10:00 window; inside the window it stays as fresh as before (takes effect after the next server restart).

releases.heading: Live news: delay readout fix
items: The behind-the-scenes 'how late did the story arrive' number for press releases no longer counts a site's first batch of older releases as late news. Nothing changes on screen; it takes effect at the next backend restart.

releases.heading: News arrives within about a minute instead of ~30-40 minutes
items: MomX news now has three live feeds on top of the regular 2-minute scan: the Alpaca/Benzinga news stream (every ticker, the moment Benzinga publishes), PR Newswire and GlobeNewswire press releases (checked every minute), and SEC's latest-filings list (checked every 30 seconds).
Before this, the typical headline reached the app about 38 minutes after it was published (measured Oct 2). The new delay will be measured after Monday's session.
Law-firm lawsuit ads ('Investors have opportunity to lead ... securities fraud lawsuit') from the wires are skipped - they are ads, not company news.
The HEADLINES line now ends with 'live feeds 3/3', or says which live feed is down.

releases.heading: News column: green ▲ / red ▼ for Jev's Bullish / Bearish
items: The scanner's News column now puts a green ▲ before the age when Jev reads the headline as Bullish and a red ▼ when it reads it as Bearish. 'Not important' headlines get no arrow. Hover still shows the headline and Jev's percentage.
Behind the scenes Jev's label is now checked every day against what the stock did 30 min, 60 min and to the close after the headline (vs SPY). First day only - not proof yet.

releases.heading: Jev news: routine SEC paperwork no longer called Bearish
items: Jev was reading Goldman Sachs' routine 424B2 note filings as a share sale ('Bearish'). Its instructions now say routine paperwork (424B2 note prospectuses, Form 4, 13F/13G, exhibit-only 8-Ks) is 'Not important', while a real share offering stays 'Bearish'. Recent headlines are re-read with the new wording.

releases.heading: News: TypeSafe Jev reads every new headline
items: Each new headline (last 48 hours) for the board's tickers is read once by TypeSafe Jev, which tags it Bullish, Bearish or Not important for that ticker with a %, e.g. 'Jev: Bullish 96%'. It shows in HEADLINES and in the News column's popup, in place of the old Strong / Neutral word.
Cost is tiny (about $0.00002 a headline). A TEST: the label is Jev's reading of the headline, not a forecast - it is being checked against what the stocks actually did before it is trusted.
Live after the main server restart (after the close, or when you say 'Restart now').

releases.heading: No more "Load failed" banner on the phone scanner
items: When the phone's connection drops a scanner refresh, the app now retries it right away (after 1.5 s, then 4 s) instead of showing the red "FetchEvent.respondWith received an error: Load failed" bar.
If the connection stays down, the bar says so in plain words and shows when the rows on screen were last updated.

releases.heading: News refreshes by itself all day
items: The 8 news sources (Yahoo, Alpaca/Benzinga, Benzinga, Finviz, Nasdaq, SEC, Finnhub) are now read automatically every 2 minutes, 4 AM - 8 PM ET - no need to press SCAN, NEWS or Refresh. Each round covers the board's current movers plus the next part of the Watchlist, so movers are re-read about every 2 minutes and every Watchlist ticker about every 25 minutes.
The News column and HEADLINES re-read the store every 2 minutes (was 5) and for every row on the board (was the first 120). Before, a 12:30 story could sit unread until someone pressed a button.

releases.heading: HEADLINES: search box
items: MomX -> NEWS -> HEADLINES has a search box: type a ticker (GEV, NVDA) to see only its headlines, or a word (earnings, upgrade) to find stories that mention it. ✕ clears it. Only tickers on the scanner board are in the news list.

releases.heading: iPhone: the screen no longer zooms in by itself
items: Tapping the ticker box, the 5m timeframe box or the colour-link box on a phone made iPhone zoom the whole page in (its rule for text under 16px) - the bottom menu and the price axis got cut off. On phone-size screens every text box and dropdown now uses 16px text, so the page stays fitted. Pinch-zoom still works.
If the page is still zoomed from before, pinch out once (or reload) to reset it.

releases.heading: SECTORS strip: strongest sector on top
items: The SECTORS list now puts the 🔥 hot / moving sectors first and, within them, the biggest average move today on top (BULL: highest first, BEAR: most negative first). Before, it sorted by how many stocks were up, so Networking +4.8% sat under AI - Power +2.5%.

releases.heading: StochasX now matches your TOS settings (two copies)
items: Your TOS chart runs two StochasX copies: D 8 WEIGHTED and D 2 HULL (both K 8, 90/10, no day limit). The chart now runs both, so the fast HULL copy adds the frequent wedges you see in TOS (LITE today: 7 red wedges 10:00-11:30, TOS about 7).
Wedge colours are your TOS plot colours: lime (191,255,0) below the candle, red (255,63,0) above.

releases.heading: New: StochasX wedges (your TOS study) + RelVol candles on
items: StochasX (shared_StochasX_v20263) is on every chart: a red ^ above the candle when the stochastic FullD drops back below 90, a lime v below when it climbs back above 10, last 2 days, on the forming candle like TOS. Switch it off in Indicators.
Relative Volume candles (shared_RelVol_Candles_v324, the small cyan/magenta 1.9-style values) are switched on, as in your TOS.

releases.heading: Background chart building no longer waits while your charts are open
items: Scanner charts that were never built now get built in the background while your chart tabs are open. Before, an open chart tab held it back to one build every 15 minutes. It still waits whenever you open a new chart.

releases.heading: Scanner charts are built in the background before you click
items: The backend now pre-builds charts for your BULL Watchlist scanner first (then Mag7, Movers, then the bear lists). Before, it spent its slots on the news and bear lists, and only 2 of the 50 Watchlist rows were ready.

Charts that had never been built are built again in the background, one at a time, and pause whenever you open a chart. A ready chart opens in under a second; a cold one took about 30 seconds after hours and up to 3 minutes during the session.

releases.heading: Scanner candles are minutes fresh, not 15-45 minutes old
items: Tickers on the live Schwab stream (about 200 of the Watchlist) now carry candles about 2 minutes behind. A server restart used to leave all of them 15-45 minutes behind until the next day.
Schwab's slower candle downloads now go first to the tickers the stream cannot carry (Schwab streams 300 symbols at most), so those catch up about twice as fast.

releases.heading: Scanner un-stuck: the board refreshes again
items: The scanner stopped updating at 12:25 ET because merging the 4-7 AM premarket candles into every ticker took most of the worker's time. That step is now about 70 times cheaper, so the board rebuilds again.

releases.heading: Signals and clouds show the same session window as TOS
items: 4x8 / 9x20 CALL/PUT bubbles, MACD, 9x20 and squeeze clouds and the cloud bands now show only the latest session from 5:00 AM ET, exactly like your TOS scripts (limit to last 1 session, start 0500). Before, they showed every loaded day from 4:00 AM.
The 15m cloud band uses your script gold (255,218,0). You can still change any of these in Indicators.

releases.heading: Charts: saved live candles no longer lost at a server restart
items: When the server stopped, an older background save of the live 1-minute candles could finish last and overwrite the newest save, losing the latest minutes. The final save now waits for it. Takes effect at the next server restart.

releases.heading: TOS parity pass: squeeze flames live, your cloud studies on, pivots like TOS
items: Squeeze flames (🔥5, 🔥15 ... 🔥4h, 🔥D) now fire on the forming candle like TOS instead of after it closes, and 🔥2h / 🔥4h / 🔥D actually appear on 1m-15m charts (they were starved of history). The current-chart flame reads 🔥5 like your script.
MTF EMA 9x20 signal clouds, squeeze clouds and the 15m cloud bands are on by default, as in your TOS; the 15m band uses your script gold (255,218,0).
PivotPoints weekly/monthly use the last completed calendar week/month (your TOS weekly pivot on CLS: 359.95).
Persons pivots pick R1/S1 vs R2/S2 exactly as your TOS script does on intraday charts.
Higher-timeframe D..M signals (CALLD, MACD-W ...) refresh every minute instead of every 30 minutes, and CALL4H vs C4H reads the real daily close (takes effect after the next server restart).

releases.heading: Scanner: newest candles straight from the live Schwab stream
items: The scanner now takes the newest 1-minute candles directly from the live Schwab stream every 15 seconds, instead of from a saved file that arrived about 4 minutes late. Streamed tickers are now about a minute behind TOS.

releases.heading: Pivot labels no longer hide behind OI walls
items: A pivot a few cents from an OI wall had its label hidden (CLS weekly pivot 359.95 under the 360 wall). Pivot names now join the wall tag instead (e.g. "31 10/2 · dPR"), at most two extra names per tag.
The Persons pivot PP line now has its own label - wPP (weekly), dPP (daily) - like the PP line TOS plots.

releases.heading: CALL/PUT bubbles (4x8, 9x20) update on every tick, like TOS
items: The 15m / 30m / 1H / 2H / 4H CALL and PUT bubbles used to appear only after the server rebuilt the chart - 1 to 6 minutes after TOS (measured this morning on SPY, AAPL and NVDA). The server now sends what the chart needs to draw, relabel or remove the forming candle bubble on every price tick.
CALL vs compact C on a forming candle now follows the current higher-timeframe trend, the way TOS repaints it.

releases.heading: Scanner: TOS data permanently - checkbox removed
items: The scanner now always runs on your TOS (Schwab) data; the TOS checkbox is gone, so there is nothing to switch. This morning it matched 33 of 49 tickers in your TOS lists, against 18 on Alpaca data.
Only today's 4:00-7:00 AM is still filled from Alpaca, because Schwab has no candles for that window - the same way the charts do it.

releases.heading: Scanner TOS mode: candles refresh continuously, not only when a scan runs
items: TOS candles were only refreshed when a full scan ran (about every 2 minutes), so some tickers - MRNA, LITE, CVX - went over an hour without fresh candles and missed the scan. A background refresher now uses Schwab's full safe allowance all the time, oldest candles first.

releases.heading: Scanner: fixed this morning's slow, stale board
items: From 9:24 the new live-stream step made every scan take 4-5 minutes instead of seconds, so the board went stale and briefly stopped answering. It now touches only the newest candles - about 1 second per full scan.
The TOS checkbox no longer disappears if the scanner briefly drops out; it keeps showing your last choice.

releases.heading: Scanner TOS mode: premarket results like TOS
items: Schwab has no candles for today before 7:00 AM, so in TOS mode the 4h volume rule compared against yesterday afternoon and blocked almost every ticker in premarket. The scanner now fills just today's 4:00-7:00 AM from Alpaca (the same way the charts do), and keeps Schwab for everything else.

releases.heading: Scanner TOS mode: newest candles from the Schwab live stream
items: With TOS ticked, the scanner now adds the newest candles from the Schwab live stream on top of the history it loads, so the scan is about 4 minutes behind instead of 10-15 for most tickers.

Safety check: for each ticker the stream is used only if its recent candles match Schwab's history exactly - if the stream had a gap, that ticker simply waits for its next history refresh, so RVOL is never thrown off.

releases.heading: Scanner TOS mode: no more 17-minute wait after a restart or switch
items: Switching TOS off and back on no longer throws away the loaded TOS data - the board comes back full at once.
The TOS data is also saved to disk every minute, so after a scanner restart the board is full straight away and just keeps refreshing. Only the very first load ever takes the ~17 minutes.

releases.heading: Scanner TOS mode: every ticker loads, including the new ETFs
items: With TOS ticked, 14 tickers (the new leveraged ETFs plus DRAM and NASA) never loaded: the small Mag7 and Movers lists kept re-reading their own tickers and told the system the daily candles were done, starving the Watchlist. Fixed - a loaded ticker is not re-read for 5 minutes, and daily candles keep their share until every list has them.

releases.heading: Bot: new MOM↑ / MOM↓ rule
items: The bot now trades the MOM tag: MOM↑ (calls) when the Squeeze Momentum line is cyan on the last 5-minute candle, MOM↓ (puts) when it is magenta. First time per stock per day, 9:30-3:30. A TEST - this plain version is not back-tested; it can fire on many stocks at once (capped at 150 a day).

releases.heading: SQZ fire: any of 2h / 4h / D / W
items: The bot's SQZ fire rule and the Setup column's SQZ tag now count a squeeze firing on 2h, 4h, Daily or Weekly (was 2h / 4h only).

releases.heading: Scanner TOS mode: loads all three candle types evenly
items: With TOS ticked the scanner shared Schwab's request allowance unevenly and almost never loaded the 30-minute candles, so only 12 of 368 tickers were ready after 9 minutes. The allowance is now split evenly, so all tickers load together.

releases.heading: ABVX rule: EMA 9/21 only; ZS and ABVX tags in the Setup column
items: ABVX rule (your update): the 5-minute close must be above EMA 9 and EMA 21, VWAP and the cloud - the 50 EMA no longer has to be cleared, so it can fire earlier. The ZS rule is unchanged (still EMA 9/21/50).
Setup column: ZS↑ 09:55 and ABVX↑ 09:39 (bear ZS↓ / ABVX↓) show the time each rule first fired today, and stay all day.

releases.heading: Scanner: TOS checkbox - choose TOS (Schwab) or Alpaca data
items: New TOS checkbox next to Scan matches only. Ticked: the scanner uses only your TOS (Schwab) data, so it matches the TOS scanner. Unticked: Alpaca data, faster to load but volume and prices can differ from TOS.

With TOS ticked, Schwab only allows a limited number of requests per minute, so the scanner loads tickers in turn (missing ones first, then the oldest) and shows 'TOS loading n/N' until all are in - about 12 minutes from a cold start. Rows you see are never blanked while they wait. The top rows' H/L and % Chg stay live either way.
Only an admin can change it, because it changes the scanner for everyone.

releases.heading: Scanner: TOS (Schwab) data only - no Alpaca
items: Every scanner candle - 5-minute, 30-minute and daily, price and volume - now comes only from Schwab, your TOS data. Alpaca is no longer used by the scanner.

Why: tonight TLN showed on our scanner but not in TOS. Schwab's 4:00 PM TLN candle closed at 312.69, but the Alpaca price made it 316.61, which passed the 1-hour rule. With Schwab only, TLN drops off - same as TOS.
Trade-off: Schwab has no candles for the current day before 7:00 AM ET, so the scanner has nothing for 4:00-7:00 AM (TOS draws those; the Schwab data feed does not serve them).

releases.heading: CloudMAX arrows and CALL5/P5 labels show live, like TOS
items: The red/lime 4x8 arrows, the 9x20 arrows and the CALL5 / P5 / CALL15 / P15 labels used to wait until the candle closed, so they showed up to 5 minutes after TOS. They now appear on the candle that is still forming, within a minute of the cross.
Like TOS, a live signal can disappear again if price turns back before the candle closes.

releases.heading: MOM↑ back to the momentum line only
items: Undone at your request after this week's test: MOM↑ no longer needs ADX above 20 or the RVOL 5 / 3 volume check. It shows again whenever the Squeeze Momentum line is cyan (above 0 and rising). The ADX + RVOL version did no better than random stocks this week (84 trades, 29% win).

releases.heading: MOM↑ (bull) also needs heavy buying volume
items: MOM↑ now needs all three: Squeeze Momentum line cyan, 5-minute ADX above 20, and RVOL 5+ on 5m or 15m OR 3+ on any of 30m / 1h / 2h / 4h / D on a buying candle (cyan / green cell). Hover the tag to see which RVOL qualified.

releases.heading: MOM↑ (bull) now needs ADX above 20
items: Setup column: MOM↑ shows only when the Squeeze Momentum line is cyan (above 0 and rising) AND the 5-minute ADX is above the yellow 20 line. The bear MOM↓ is unchanged. Still shown only, not a bot rule.

releases.heading: Bot leaderboard: 7 more columns
items: New columns after ROI: Profit factor ($ won / $ lost - above 1 made money), Avg win, Avg loss, Best trade, Worst trade, Days + (days it made money / days it traded), Trades / day. All sort high / low / off.

releases.heading: Bot leaderboard: 'Most trades + best win %'
items: Bot -> Leaderboard has a 'Min trades' switch (All / 20+ / 50+ / 100+) and a one-click 'Most trades + best win %' button: rules with 50+ trades, best win rate on top. Pick 1W (or 3D) at the top for the whole week. Your choice is remembered.

releases.heading: Scanner: third click on a column header = no sort
items: Every sortable column (Scanner and History) now cycles high-to-low, low-to-high, then NO SORT - the arrow disappears and the rows go back to the scanner's own order. Symbol and Industry start A-Z.

releases.heading: Scanner: % Chg now moves live
items: % Chg now updates from the live price every few seconds (same formula: live price vs the previous close), so it tracks TOS instead of waiting for the next full scan. Sorting by % Chg re-sorts live.
From 4:00 PM it keeps the scan's value, because after-hours prices gave wrong session changes when this was tried before.

releases.heading: Chart labels no longer pile into one long line
items: On cheap stocks (e.g. MNKD at $3.97) many moving-average labels sat a few cents apart and joined into one line so long it ran across the whole phone chart and pushed the LIVE price off-screen. The LIVE price now always stands alone, a name never repeats, and at most two names share a tag - the rest show as "+N".

releases.heading: Live prices: found why they kept freezing
items: Every 30 seconds the app saved a 10 MB file of 1-minute candles, and it did that inside the live Schwab connection - so while the file was being written (often minutes on a busy server), no prices were read at all. The app still said connected and logged no error.
The save now runs on its own background thread, so the live connection keeps reading prices the whole time.

releases.heading: Scanner live prices: no more 40-minute-old prices
items: Schwab's quote feed was only updating AAPL, and a partial update could wipe a ticker's last price, so the scanner's live H/L was using prices up to 40 minutes old (or none).
The live layer now keeps each ticker's last price and falls back to Schwab's latest 1-minute candle whenever the quote is older - so H/L and its sort use a price at most about a minute old.

releases.heading: TOS 4x8 red / green arrows now show on the chart
items: The big red (down) and lime (up) arrows TOS draws when EMA 4 crosses EMA 8 come from the CloudMax MTF study, which was switched off in the app. It is now on for every chart, e.g. TEAM 5m today: red 11:20, green 11:55, red 12:05.
You can still switch it off in Indicators; the app will not turn it back on.

releases.heading: Charts: AutoFib 50% line continues in cyan past the last candle, like TOS
items: The AutoFib 50% line now carries on from the last candle to the price axis in cyan, the way your TOS chart draws it in the empty space on the right. Over the candles it still turns cyan or magenta by each candle's close.

releases.heading: Charts: your TOS AutoFib study is on
items: AutoFib (shared_AutoFib_SingleTF_v20263) is now on for every chart with your TOS settings: daily candles, lookback 20, the 50% line (cyan above / magenta below), the 61.8% or 38.2% line and the cloud; high/low lines off.

It used a 40-day lookback before, so its line did not match TOS. On TEAM the 20-day high 200.00 and low 168.05 put the 50% line at 184.03, the same as your TOS chart. You can still turn it off or change the lookback in the chart's study settings.

releases.heading: MomX scanner refreshes sooner
items: The scanner now downloads its 5-minute, 30-minute and daily candles at the same time instead of one after another, so each new scan lands sooner. The limit on requests to Schwab stays the same.
While a new scan is building, the banner says the rows on screen are the previous scan.

releases.heading: Live prices: fixed the freeze at 10:43 AM
items: Live prices froze at 10:43 AM because the app asked Schwab to stream 345 tickers and Schwab allows 300 - it refused the whole connection, and the app kept showing the last prices as if they were live.
The app now never asks for more than 300. Your open charts always come first; the per-second lightning-bolt check covers the top 200 scanner rows.

releases.heading: Scanner: H/L and its sort now move live, like TOS
items: The H/L column now updates from the live price every few seconds (same TOS formula: 2-hour candles, extended hours, last 8), and the board re-sorts as it changes - it no longer waits for the next full scan.
Added 13 leveraged ETFs from your TOS results to the Watchlist (SNOU, OKLL, AMZU, PALU, RDTL, MSFU, GGLL, QBTX, AAPU, CONL, MSTX, MSTU, TSLQ). PALU stays hidden because it has no listed options.

releases.heading: MTF MACD clouds (5m/15m/30m/1h/2h/4h) switched on
items: Your TOS study shared_Cloud_Signal_MACD_v20263 was already built into the chart as "MTF MACD 6/12/8 Trend Clouds" but was switched off. It is now on for every chart: teal cloud when MACD 6/12/8 crosses above zero with EMA 9 over 20, pink when it crosses below with EMA 9 under 20, for Current, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h and 4h, last 1 session, 5:00-16:00.
You can still switch it off in Indicators; the app will not turn it back on.

releases.heading: Scanner refresh: overlap independent data downloads
items: Scanner data downloads now overlap instead of waiting for each full watchlist download in turn, while keeping the same limit on simultaneous Schwab requests. Candle history and scan rules are unchanged.
During startup, the scanner now explicitly says that visible matches belong to the previous scan until a fresh complete result arrives.

releases.heading: Scanner: H/L column back to 2-hour candles over 8
items: The H/L column is back to your TOS watchlist column's settings: 2-hour candles, extended hours on, the last 8 candles. The 10-minute version from earlier this morning is undone.

releases.heading: Scanner: H/L column matches your TOS column settings
items: The H/L column now uses your TOS column's settings: 10-minute candles, extended hours on, the last 3 candles (it used 2-hour candles over 8). It shows where the price sits in its very recent range, so it reacts much faster than before.

releases.heading: Charts open fast after hours and never show old days
items: After 8 PM ET and at weekends, opening or switching back to a chart could show old candles (e.g. last Friday on DIA) for a minute or more, because the app asked the server to rebuild the whole chart - which cannot add any candles when the market is closed. It now just reloads the latest chart, which takes about a second.
During market hours (4 AM - 8 PM ET) nothing changes.

releases.heading: Scanner: candles now built the way TOS builds them
items: Candle prices now follow the exchange rule TOS uses: late-reported trades (like DOCU's 4:50 PM print at $66.98) add volume but no longer move a candle's price. That fake price had put DOCU on the scanner when TOS did not show it.
Volume still comes from Schwab, always asked over the same full history, so RVOL matches TOS (LASR 2h: 3.1 in TOS, 3.15 here).
Checked on all 358 tickers at 12:30 AM ET: the scanner passed LASR only - the same 1 of 1 your TOS showed.

releases.heading: Scanner: consistent TOS candles and verified H/L settings
items: Refreshes now request the same Schwab history window as the initial load. Previously a shorter request changed settled candles and moved LASR's RVOL away from TOS after the first refresh.
Successful history updates also remove previously cached Schwab candles that the source has retracted, so an obsolete final print cannot keep a crossover active.
H/L now uses the verified TOS column configuration: 10-minute bars, length 3, extended hours on. It previously used 2-hour bars and length 8.
Candle merging now processes rows in batches to reduce scanner rebuild time, with identical results in the before/after comparison.

releases.heading: Bot: GO+ now shows its full name
items: The Bot page's 'GO+' rule is now labelled 'GO+ (GO + short RVOL + MACD)' so it matches the Setup column tag.

releases.heading: Scanner: consistent session change and original RVOL colours
items: The change column now uses the scanner's session percentage consistently. After-hours prices no longer turn LASR's -1.37% session change into a positive percentage.
RVOL cells retain the study's original colours, including older readings. Their age remains visible and older readings do not pulse as fresh signals.
TOS parity remains under investigation: Schwab API candle data can differ from the TOS desktop chart, so matching formulas alone does not guarantee matching ticker lists.

releases.heading: Scanner: restore the TOS two-bar volume comparison
items: The required 4-hour volume rule now compares against two bars ago, as verified in your TOS filter, instead of the older three-bar workaround. This removes matches that passed only against a different, low-volume bar.

The price-change calculation now follows the exact TOS study formula. The 1-hour threshold stays at 0.3%, confirmed in the live TOS scan. Matching ticker lists still depends on matching candle data and refresh times.

releases.heading: Scanner: 1-hour price rule back to 0.3%
items: Your live TOS Stock Hacker scan reads 0.3% on the 1-hour close rule, so the scanner is back to 0.3% (it was briefly 0.25% from the pasted notes).

releases.heading: Scanner: candles now come from your Schwab (TOS) data
items: The MomX scanner's 5-minute and 30-minute candles now come from Schwab, the same data as your TOS. Before, they came from Alpaca, which counted 30-110% more shares per candle, so RVOL and the 4h volume rule read different numbers than TOS.
Alpaca only fills what Schwab does not have: today's 4:00-7:00 AM candles, days older than about 20 days, and everything if Schwab is down. Daily candles are unchanged (they already matched TOS).

releases.heading: Scanner: 1-hour price rule now 0.25% (was 0.3%)
items: The MomX BULL scan's required 1-hour rule now matches your TOS scan: the 1-hour close must be at least 0.25% above two bars ago (it was 0.3%). A few more tickers can now pass. The BEAR scan mirrors it (a 0.25% drop).

releases.heading: Premarket: scanner candles live from Schwab (7:00-9:30 AM)
items: Premarket CALL2H / CALL4H showed on the scanner a median 16 minutes after your chart (the scanner's premarket candles came from a delayed Alpaca feed). From 7:00 AM ET the newest candles now come from Schwab - the same data as your chart - so premarket arrows should show within about a minute.
Before 7:00 AM Schwab has no candles, so 4:00-7:00 is unchanged. Regular hours are unchanged. Will be measured on tomorrow's premarket.

releases.heading: Chart arrows: bull and bear share the work
items: The BULL and BEAR scanners now fetch each stock's chart history and work out its CALL/PUT arrows once, instead of twice - so checking every Watchlist stock (the CHPT fix) costs half as much.

releases.heading: Chart arrows for EVERY Watchlist stock (CHPT fix)
items: CHPT 09-29: the chart showed C2H at 9:45 and C4H at 10:30, but the scanner only worked out chart arrows for graded / scan-match rows - CHPT had no grade until the 1:05 PM news, so the scanner (and the bot) never saw them in the morning.
Now every non-ETF row gets its CALL2H / C2H / CALL4H / C4H arrows checked too - graded rows every minute as before, the rest every 5 minutes.
Live after the worker restart (after today's close, or when you say 'Restart now').

releases.heading: Charts load faster again (High OI flash made lighter)
items: The High OI wall flash was redrawing every chart about 7 times a second, which slowed charts down on the phone. The flash is now a light glow over the line that costs almost nothing, so charts load and scroll at normal speed again. It still flashes the same way.

releases.heading: Setup column: Squeeze Momentum line tag (MOM↑ / MOM↓)
items: MOM↑ (cyan) on the BULL board when the chart's Squeeze Momentum line is above 0 and rising on the last 5-minute candle; MOM↓ (magenta) on the BEAR board when it is below 0 and falling. Same numbers as the chart's lower study.
Shown only - not a rule and not in the bot. Back-test Sep 1-28: ADX with this line did the same as random stocks.
Live after the worker restart (after today's close, or when you say 'Restart now').

releases.heading: Daily line rules now include SPY and QQQ
items: 'Daily line', 'Daily line $100' and 'Gap reclaim' now take SPY and QQQ (the only ETFs they take - every other ETF is still skipped). The bot tracks real SPY / QQQ option prices when they fire.
September on the same rule (stock moves, few trades): SPY calls +0.35% avg over 4, puts -0.16%; QQQ calls +0.34% over 7, puts -0.50% over 3. A TEST.
Live after the worker restart (after today's close, or when you say 'Restart now').

releases.heading: High OI list: the biggest wall flashes
items: On the option chain High OI tab, the biggest call wall and the biggest put wall now flash their strike and OI number.

releases.heading: Every OI wall number flashes again
items: All OI amount tags on the chart flash. Only the High OI wall on each side (the biggest) also flashes its line and stays thicker.

releases.heading: Only the High OI walls flash
items: Back to flashing only the High OI wall on each side (the biggest one): its line and its OI number flash. The other walls stay still.

releases.heading: MX A+ rule updated (your changes)
items: RVOL: cyan (3 or more) on ANY of 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h or D - one timeframe is enough (e.g. 15m at 5 while 30m is 1). Was 15m-2h.
Skittles: cyan or green on ANY of D to Mo (lime and the trend-only read no longer count). Bear: magenta or red.
Removed: the biggest call wall above the price within 2x the expected move (bear: the put wall below).
Live after the worker restart (after today's close, or when you say 'Restart now'). The new version is not back-tested yet.

releases.heading: Bot Trades: Entry time and Exit time columns
items: Bot -> Trades now shows 'Entry time' and 'Exit time' (ET) as their own columns; both sort. 'Time' is renamed 'Signal' (when the rule fired).
Entry time is the signal time until the worker restarts after today's close; from then it is the exact minute the option was priced.

releases.heading: Every OI wall number flashes
items: All OI amount tags on the chart (e.g. "2.1K 10/9") now flash, not just the biggest wall. Only the biggest wall per side also flashes its line and stays thicker.

releases.heading: Biggest OI wall: the OI number flashes too
items: The OI amount tag on the biggest wall each side (e.g. "6.4K 9/30") now flashes together with its line, so you can read which strike it is.

releases.heading: Chart OI walls: pick 3 / 5 / 10 per side, biggest wall flashes
items: Option chain (Chain tab colour key and High OI tab) has a new CHART WALLS / SIDE picker: 3, 5 or 10. Every chart follows it. Default is 10.
The biggest OI wall on each side (calls above price, puts below) is drawn a little thicker than the other walls and slowly flashes, so it stands out.
The flash pauses while you drag or zoom the chart.

releases.heading: Your $100 daily-line rule: bot, Setup column and FILTERS
items: New rule 'Daily line $100': a $100+ stock opens above yesterday's high (puts: below yesterday's low) with $0.50 of room to the next daily line, then a 5-minute close above the 21 EMA (puts: below) with rising volume or momentum, 9:35-11:00.
Setup column shows $LINE↑ / $LINE↓ with the time. FILTERS -> More rules (tests) -> 'Daily line $100+'.
Back-test Sep 1-28: the calls beat random $100+ stocks in both halves of the month (held to the close). The puts showed no edge. Still a TEST - the bot records real option prices.

releases.heading: Scanner: daily-line trades in the Setup column and FILTERS
items: Setup column: LINE↑ 09:45 (bear LINE↓) when the daily-line rule fires, RECLAIM↑ / RECLAIM↓ for the gap-reclaim (ZS 09-28). They flash for 10 minutes and stay all day.
FILTERS -> More rules (tests): 'Daily line' and 'Gap reclaim' on both boards.

releases.heading: Bot: your daily-line trade, as two new test rules
items: 'Daily line': one of the 30 biggest stocks opens above yesterday's high (calls) or below yesterday's low (puts), and the 5-minute candle closes on that side of the 21 EMA with rising volume or momentum. Read 9:35-11:00.
'Gap down, took back yesterday's low' (the ZS 09-28 move): opened below yesterday's low and the first 5-minute candle closed back above it - calls. Mirror for puts.

Both are TESTS. Back-test Sep 1-28: daily-line calls did better than random but on few trades; daily-line puts were no better than random; the ZS pattern flipped between the two halves of the month. The bot now records real option prices for them.

releases.heading: Bot: no more skipped trades, plus SOLO and 🔥#1/#2
items: The bot no longer stops after 15 (or 40) trades per rule a day. On 09-28 C2H, CALL2H, ADX, SKIT and Sector moving all hit that limit and later signals were skipped.
New trades are priced first, so the entry price is taken right at the signal instead of waiting 10-15 minutes behind open trades.
New bot rules: SOLO (big money into one stock) and 🔥#1/#2 hot-sector leaders. Bull side only; both are tests, never back-tested as options.

releases.heading: Bot: bear MX A+ and bear Market turn now traded
items: The virtual bot now takes the BEAR MX A+ and the BEAR Market turn picks (put side), same as bull. Before this they showed on the bear board but the bot skipped them.
Not back-tested - bear versions are tests. No real orders are sent.

releases.heading: FILTERS: the new rules, on the BEAR board too
items: FILTERS -> A/A+ Setup: 'MomoX A+' now works on the BEAR board (the bear MX A+).

New group 'More rules (tests)': Market turn, 🔥 Sector leaders (bear: falling-sector leaders), ZS rule (bear: below every line with a clear path down) and Short arrows C2H/C4H (bear: P2H/P4H). Each reads the board you are on.

releases.heading: Bear bot: the same rules as the bull bot
items: The virtual bot now trades the same rule list on the BEAR board (puts) as on the bull board: GO, GO+, ⭐1, MX A+, Daily 2, Market turn, P2H/P4H, PUT2H/4H, ADX magenta, SKIT, RVOL, SQZ fire, ZS rule, ZS (no day-low), ABVX rule (down), 🔥 Sector falling (early) and 🔥 Sector falling.

New bear versions: MX A+ (news + magenta RVOL + squeeze fired down + bearish Skittles + a big PUT wall below), Market turn (SPY pops above VWAP, then falls back below -> the 5 weakest stocks), ZS/ABVX (below every line, clear path down), falling sectors (60%+ of a sector down and below VWAP). The bear board's Setup column shows bear MX A+ and bear Market turn too.
None of the bear versions is back-tested - no bear mirror has shown an edge yet. The Bot page (BEAR switch) will show how they do with real put prices.

releases.heading: MX A+ accepts a 30m / 1h / 2h / 4h / D / W squeeze
items: MomoX A+ now counts a squeeze firing on ANY of 30 minute, 1 hour, 2 hour, 4 hour, Daily or Weekly (was 2h/4h/D/W). The 30m and 1h squeezes are new scanner readings used only by MX A+ - the SQZ columns, your TOS scan and the A+/A grade are unchanged. The 30m/1h part is not back-tested; the Bot page will show how MX A+ does with it.

releases.heading: Bot tables: no frozen column
items: No column stays pinned any more when you swipe a Bot table sideways - the whole table scrolls together. Tables still scroll inside their own box on the phone.

releases.heading: Bot page scrolls properly on the phone
items: On a phone the Bot page no longer stretches wider than the screen: each table scrolls left/right inside its own box with the first column (rule, time, day) pinned, and the range buttons scroll sideways instead of running off the screen.

releases.heading: Bot page: tabs, sortable columns, ROI in Trades
items: The Bot page is split into tabs - Leaderboard, Trades, Winners by period, Momentum at entry, Day by day, Rules explained - so it is short and easy to scroll. The chosen tab is remembered; clicking a rule opens its trades.
Every column can be sorted: click once for high first, again for low first, a third time to go back. Period and momentum columns sort the rules by ROI in that column.

Trades: the 'Your exit' column is now labelled 'ROI (your exit)' (per trade they are the same number), and the header shows the total for the trades on screen - wins, losses, $ profit, money spent and ROI.

releases.heading: Bot page: ROI
items: ROI (profit ÷ what the contracts cost, 1 contract per trade) is now on the Bot page: a top card, a column in the rule leaderboard and Day by day, and in every Winners-by-period cell. Rules with pricier contracts no longer look better just because their dollar total is bigger.

releases.heading: ⚡ list survives a server restart
items: After a server restart the day's ⚡ bolts are listed straight away from the saved file (they read 0 until a new price tick came in).

releases.heading: ⚡ bolt runs all session; ⚡ TODAY lists every bolt of the day
items: The ⚡ bolt now runs the whole session (09:25-16:05 ET) whether or not a MomX screen is open - before, it only ran while a page was open, so on 09-28 nothing before 12:06 PM was caught. ETFs are left out, like every other rule.
⚡ TODAY now lists every stock that fired a bolt today (with Scan matches only ticked too); ⚡ NOW still shows the ones firing this second.

releases.heading: Negative sectors leave the BULL board
items: A 🔥 sector that turns negative for the day is now removed from the BULL board completely (it was shown 'cooled'). Falling sectors appear only on the BEAR board.

releases.heading: Sector 🔥 follows the board's direction
items: BULL board: a 🔥 sector that has turned negative for the day is shown cooled ('was 🔥 · now -2.4%') instead of HOT - e.g. Networking on 09-28.

BEAR board: 🔥 now marks FALLING sectors - 60%+ of the sector's stocks down and below VWAP, median move -0.5% or worse (top 3), with the weakest stocks listed (e.g. Crypto, Solar, Space on 09-28). Shown for context; not back-tested.

releases.heading: Bot keeps 180 days
items: The virtual bot now keeps 180 days of trades (was 90). The Bot page has a 180D button, and its 'All' column and Day-by-day table reach back up to 180 days.

releases.heading: Fading no longer blocks any rule
items: Your call: fading momentum no longer blocks MX A+ either - no rule blocks on fading. The ⚠ fading warning still shows next to a setup, and every bot trade records its momentum at entry, so the Bot page's 'Momentum at entry' table shows how fading trades really do.

releases.heading: Bot page: Momentum at entry
items: Every bot trade now records the 5-minute momentum state it was taken in (Building / Holding / Extended / Fading / Quiet). A new 'Momentum at entry' table on the Bot page shows each rule's wins-losses and average option % per state, best state per rule highlighted - so real option prices show which momentum state wins for each rule. Starts with trades from the 4:10 PM restart on.

releases.heading: Fading blocks MX A+ only
items: Changed after checking the data: momentum FADING now blocks only MX A+ (its tag reads 'MX A+ … · FADING, no trade', no ⚡). In the back-test fading MX A+ picks averaged -0.19% vs +0.54%, while for GO+, Market turn and ⭐1 fading made no difference (14 of Market turn's 36 winners were fading). Every other rule trades as before; the bot still records the skipped MX A+ signals.

releases.heading: Fading = no trade; Bot scoreboard by period; ABVX rule test
items: Your rule: when 5-minute momentum is FADING, no trade on any rule. The Setup column shows one 'FADING · no trade' tag instead of the setups (hover lists what was hidden), no ⚡ or pop-up card, FILTERS strategies and ⭐ ranking skip the row, and the virtual bot does not buy it (it records the skipped signal to check later).

Bot page: new 'Winners by period' table - every rule's wins-losses and average % for 1D, 2D, 3D, 4D, 1W, 2W, 3W, 1M and All, best rule highlighted - plus a 'Day by day' table. Range buttons now Today/2D/3D/4D/1W/2W/3W/1M/90D.
New bot test rule 'ABVX rule': 09:30-10:30, above EMA 9/21/50 + VWAP + 5m cloud, no level within +$0.50, and a live 2H/4H chart arrow.
The fading rule and the ABVX rule start after the scanner restarts (4:10 PM).

releases.heading: Bot trades sector leaders (test)
items: Two new test rules on the Bot page: '🔥 Sector (hot)' - a leader (up and above VWAP) of one of the day's two HOT sectors - and '🔥 Sector (moving)' - a leader of a 'moving now' sector, like Cybersecurity on 09-28 (PANW, ZS, CRWD, NET). First 15 a day each, real option prices.
Back-test for reference: members of a HOT sector +0.59% a trade (34% hit +2% first); of a moving-now sector +0.15%. Starts after the 4:10 PM scanner restart.

releases.heading: Market turn: one turn for every list
items: The market turn (SPY back above its VWAP after the morning dip) is now one market-wide event: the first time any list sees it, every list uses that time. On 2026-09-28 Movers and Mag7 saw it at 10:10 while the Watchlist only fired at 12:20 (SPY was just 9 cents above VWAP), so ABVX and the other Watchlist picks came two hours late.

releases.heading: Chart arrows: redrawn and vanished arrows shown honestly; bot takes the chain's ENTRY strike
items: A CALL2H/CALL4H arrow the chart redraws onto an earlier candle now shows WHEN it actually appeared, with a ↺ (ABVX: the '09:00' CALL2H only existed from 13:04, when the 4-hour candle closed).
An arrow the chart later removes (a forming candle that crossed back) now stays in the Setup column, struck through with the time it vanished (✕), instead of disappearing without a trace.
The bot takes up to 40 C2H/C4H and 40 CALL2H/4H arrows a day (was 15), at the first moment the scanner sees them, and never 'buys' an arrow that has already vanished.
Every bot trade now also follows the chain's ENTRY strike (the out-of-the-money option with delta just under 0.20) - shown as its own column on the Bot page.
New test rule 'ZS (no day-high block)': your ZS rule where today's own high does not count as a level in the way.
The Bot page has a 'Rules explained' card: what each rule means and needs, and its back-test result.

releases.heading: Bot tests your ZS rule too
items: The virtual bot now also takes (as a test, first 15 a day) your ZS rule: a 5-minute close above EMA 9/21/50, VWAP and the 5m Ichimoku cloud, with no level (day high, premarket high, prior-day high, pivot P/R1/R2) within 2% above. Shown as 'ZS rule (test)' on the Bot page.
Not included in the live check: the 9eD/21eD and weekly MA lines and the High-OI wall. The Sep 1-25 back-test found no edge (about 0% a trade); this measures what the real options do.

releases.heading: New Bot page (admin only): which rule wins, which tickers, P/L
items: A new 'Bot' page in the left menu, under MomX Scanner, visible to admin accounts only (the server also refuses the data to anyone else). The BOT section on the MomX page is gone.

Top cards: total P/L per contract, win rate, average trade, trades, best and worst rule. A rule leaderboard ranked by average %; click a rule to see its trades. Trades table with ticker, option, entry, exit, P/L % and $, why it exited, the 0DTE result and the hold-to-max result. BULL/BEAR switch and Today / 5D / 20D / 90D.

Every virtual trade is now scored four ways: your exit (first 5-minute close below VWAP or the 21 EMA, else 15:50), the same signal on a 0DTE option, the weekly held for its best price until it expires, and the 15:50 close.
The bot works 09:30-16:00 ET (new trades until 15:30) and keeps 90 days of data.
The new exits and the page's data start after the 4:10 PM scanner restart.

releases.heading: Virtual bot takes ⭐1 too
items: Every stock that becomes ⭐1 on a board (the same ranking as the Setup column: GO in a 🔥 sector, then GO, then OPT seen before 10:00; fewer ⚠ first) gets one virtual option trade, shown as '⭐1' in the BOT panel and ranked on the 4 PM scorecard.
Starts with the 4:10 PM scanner restart.

releases.heading: Virtual bot takes every Setup tag - see who wins each day
items: Besides GO+, GO, MX A+, Daily 2 and Market turn, the virtual bot now also takes the first 15 a day of each Setup tag: C2H/C4H, CALL2H/4H, ADX cyan, SKIT, RVOL and SQZ fire (bull board), each priced with a real option and shown on its own line marked '(test)'.
The 4 PM scorecard ranks every rule by average option % per trade - today, and over all live days - so you can see who is winning.
Starts after the scanner restarts (after 4 PM, so it begins clean tomorrow).

releases.heading: Virtual bot now also takes C2H / C4H arrows (as a test)
items: The virtual bot takes the first 10 C2H / C4H chart arrows each day (bull board), priced with real options, shown as 'C2H/C4H (test)' in the BOT panel and on the 4 PM scorecard.
It is a test, not a proven rule: on stock prices the arrows alone did no better than random picks in the Sep 1-25 back-test. This shows what the options actually did.
Starts after the scanner restarts.

releases.heading: Virtual BOT panel on MomX (admin only)
items: A new BOT section under SECTORS shows the virtual bot's trades for today: at each GO+, GO, MX A+, Daily 2 and market-turn signal it 'buys' the nearest weekly out-of-the-money option at the real mid price, then shows the price now, P/L %, best and worst, and the close at 15:50.
No orders are ever sent - it is paper tracking with real option quotes.
Totals per rule (e.g. 'GO+ 2 · 2 up 0 down · +114%'). Collapses with its v arrow, like SECTORS.
Only admin accounts receive it; the server never sends the trades to other users.

releases.heading: Premarket scanner catches earlier movers
items: The premarket scanner now counts a 2-hour crossover from the 7:00 AM candle (was 8:00 AM) and a 4-hour crossover from the 5:00 AM candle (was 7:00 AM). This morning NVDA gapped up with CALL4H at 5 AM and CALL2H at 7 AM and never showed - it would now.

This no longer matches the TOS AlertX Bull Momo scan exactly. Back-test (9 tickers, Dec 2025 - Sep 2026): the extra rows did no better than a random ticker after the open, so treat them as 'already moving', not as a stronger setup.
Takes effect after the backend restarts after today's close.

releases.heading: Only the newest Skittles cross blinks
items: Skittles crosses that happened at different times now get their own SKIT pill, newest first (e.g. 'SKIT↑ 4h 4D 10:56' then 'SKIT↑ 2h W 10:23'). Only the newest one blinks, for its first 10 minutes.

releases.heading: SKIT time = when the cross FIRST appeared
items: On a candle that is still forming, a Skittles cross can switch off and back on (BB 4D: first at 09:47, back at 11:01). The SKIT tag now uses the first time and hides it once that is more than 60 minutes old.

releases.heading: MomoX A+ fixed (it could never fire), Skittles 'any', fresh SKIT tag
items: MomoX A+ had not fired since the High OI check went in on Sep 26: the option chain always came back labelled 'refreshing', and the check wrongly treated that as unusable. It now checks the chain's own date - today's chain counts.
MomoX A+ Skittles is now ANY one of D, 2D, 3D, 4D, W or Mo bullish (it was ALL six). The squeeze fire was already ANY of 2h, 4h, D or W.
The SKIT tag in Setup now shows only a Skittles cross the scanner saw happen in the last 60 minutes, with its time (e.g. 'SKIT↑ 4h 11:01'). Blocks that have been painted for days no longer show.
The MomoX A+ change takes effect when the scanner worker restarts.

releases.heading: Simpler Setup column, plus a MomoX A+ filter
items: The Setup column now shows only: ⚡, GO+, GO, ⭐1, MX A+, ⚠ warnings, ADX (info), the chart arrows (CALL2H/CALL4H, C2H/C4H), SQZ fires with their time, Skittles breaks (SKIT↑ 2h 4h D ... Mo) and a new RVOL↑ tag listing the timeframes where RVOL is painted cyan/green right now.
V2, V3, Daily 2, G, OPT, SOLO, market turn and hot-leader tags are hidden from Setup (they still run in FILTERS and on the 4 PM scorecard).
Only GO, GO+ and MX A+ light the ⚡ and pop a card now.
FILTERS -> A/A+ Setup has a new 'MomoX A+ (bull)' choice that shows only today's MX A+ tickers.

releases.heading: Warnings now show on Daily 2, V2, V3 and GO+ too
items: The ⚠ warning (momentum fading, below VWAP, 30m sellers, up 8%+, bad news) used to appear only next to GO, OPT, SOLO, market turn and MX A+. It now also appears next to V2, V3, Daily 2 and GO+ (GO + RVOL + MACD) - e.g. AAPL this morning: "D2 #1 ⚠ fading · below VWAP". Display only; the rules are unchanged.

releases.heading: ⚠ warnings visible on the phone again
items: On a phone the Setup column is narrow, and the ⚠ warning (e.g. "⚠ fading · below VWAP") ran past the cell under the % Chg column, so it could not be seen. It now wraps inside the Setup cell - the row just gets a little taller.

releases.heading: Signals now remember the High OI walls and expected move
items: For your checklist items that need option data (break of a High OI level, retest of the OI level below, is the trade within the expected move): at each tracked signal the scanner now saves the top 3 call and put OI walls and the expected move from the live chain. Past chains were never saved, so these can only be tested from Monday forward - after a few weeks they can be back-tested like the rest.

releases.heading: Only stocks: no rule fires on an ETF
items: GO, OPT, Best / ⭐ Star, GO + RVOL + MACD, MX A+, Daily 2 / V2 / V3, SOLO, market turn, hot-sector leaders, the option tracker and the 4 PM scorecard now skip ETFs. ETFs still show on the board (SPY / QQQ for context) - they just never get a setup tag.

Which tickers are ETFs comes from the official US listing directory (Nasdaq Trader, ETF Y/N for every listed security), not the industry label - the label missed IBIT (said Crypto) and DRAM (said Semis). The list refreshes itself weekly.

releases.heading: Real OPTION results for your rules (tracked live from Monday)
items: Every back-test so far scored the STOCK. From Monday, at each GO, GO + RVOL + MACD, MX A+, Daily 2 and market-turn signal the scanner prices one real contract - the nearest out-of-the-money call (bull) or put (bear) on the nearest expiry after today - and follows it every 10 minutes to the close.

The 4 PM scorecard then shows OPTION lines per rule: how many closed up, the option % at the close, the best % it reached, and how many touched +50%. Prices are the bid/ask middle - a real fill is usually a little worse.

releases.heading: News flash toned down: green or red only, no fill
items: The News column no longer fills the cell. Positive news pulses green and negative pulses red - the age and its star only. Neutral and unjudged stories look exactly as before.

Hover (desktop) or tap the newspaper icon (phone) to read the word: 'Positive news', 'Negative news' or 'Neutral news'. When the AI reader judged the story it also names the category, e.g. '(AI read: UPGRADE)'; otherwise '(keyword read)'.
Clicking or tapping the News cell itself now opens the story popover too, same as the newspaper icon.

releases.heading: GO + short RVOL + MACD filter for BULL and BEAR
items: Choose GO + short RVOL + MACD under FILTERS > A/A+ Setup. BULL requires cyan short-timeframe RVOL and rising MACD; BEAR requires magenta RVOL and falling MACD. Both use completed 5-minute MACD and completed 30-minute buyer or seller confirmation alongside GO.
Matching rows show GO+ or a magenta GO+ down-arrow badge. Confirmation is checked each refresh from 09:30 to 15:30 ET, and the selected filter is remembered. Bear performance has not been backtested.

releases.heading: News cell says positive or negative
items: In the MomX News column, positive news flashes green and negative news flashes red - the age and its star only, no fill. Neutral or unjudged stories look exactly as before.

Hover the cell on the desktop and the first line reads 'Positive news', 'Negative news' or 'Neutral news'. When the AI reader judged the story it also names the category, e.g. '(AI read: UPGRADE)'; otherwise it says '(keyword read)', the scraper's keyword score.
On the phone, tap the row's news to open it: the same word sits at the top of the popover.
A story nobody has judged yet stays uncoloured, exactly as before - no guess is made.

releases.heading: GO + short RVOL + MACD now works on BEAR
items: Select GO + short RVOL + MACD, then switch to BEAR for the selling-side setup: bear A/A+, gap down and go, magenta RVOL on any of 5m/15m/30m, falling MACD below its signal on a completed 5-minute candle, and sellers in control on completed 30-minute candles.

Bear matches show a magenta GO+ down-arrow badge. Switching back to BULL restores the buying-side checks. Both sides require fresh completed candles and recheck each refresh. The bear version has not been backtested; the bull win rate does not apply.

releases.heading: New GO + short RVOL + MACD filter
items: FILTERS > A/A+ Setup now offers GO + short RVOL + MACD (bull only). It requires GO, cyan RVOL on any of 5m/15m/30m, rising MACD above its signal on a completed 5-minute candle, and buyers in control on completed 30-minute candles.

Matching rows show a GO+ badge with the confirmation candle time in ET. The filter checks each refresh from 09:30 to 15:30 ET and removes rows when confirmation fades. Its RVOL/MACD checks are built in; the separate filter controls do not change them. This experimental setup does not guarantee a winning trade.

releases.heading: FILTERS now work the right way on the BEAR scanner
items: On BEAR, the SQZ and Skittles filters were still picking BULLISH signals (squeeze fired up, bullish crosses) - the opposite of a put scanner. Now one filter setting works on both: on BEAR each ticked colour means its down-side twin (SQZ fired up -> fired down; Skittles EMA/MACD crosses up -> the same crosses down), using the app's own bear rules.

On BEAR the panel shows the down-side colours and wording, the summary line says "bearish", the ⭐ star marks bearish crosses, and the History search's "buyers winning" becomes "sellers winning". BULL is unchanged. RVOL "bullish only", the strategy presets (GO/OPT/Best/V2/V3/Daily 2), grade and momentum already read the bear side.

releases.heading: Real RVOL: closing-auction and old readings are dimmed
items: RVOL numbers still match TOS exactly. But a reading that comes from the 3:50-4:10 PM closing auction (end-of-day fund orders - on Friday 55% of names lit up on the 4:00 candle) or from an earlier day now shows as a grey outlined box instead of bright cyan, and never pulses as live. Hover it to see why.

Tested first: changing the RVOL formula itself (market-hours-only or same-time-of-day) did NOT pick better stocks, and the opening readings actually help Daily 2 and MomoX A+ - so only the display changed.

releases.heading: Scanner links to your charts, like thinkorswim
items: A colour square now sits top-left in the MomX scanner - the same 9 link colours as your charts (Red, Yellow, Green...). Click any ticker in the scanner (Live or History) and the app jumps to Charts and puts that ticker in EVERY chart of that colour. Each chart keeps its own timeframe; charts of other colours do not change; saved layouts are never touched.
No chart of that colour on screen? The active chart takes it, so you always land on a chart showing the ticker. The option chain follows the ticker.

Works from the detached scanner window too: click there and the main window charts change. Each scanner window remembers its own colour (starts on Red). The lightning badge still opens the ticker card; your floating scanner windows and cards are still there when you come back.

releases.heading: MomX NEWS reads seven real sources, no guesswork
items: NEWS now pulls headlines from Yahoo Finance (search + RSS), Alpaca/Benzinga, Benzinga's own feed, Finviz, Nasdaq and SEC EDGAR filings - and a headline lands on a ticker only when the publisher itself tagged that ticker. Nothing is matched by guessing from the words.

Press NEWS: the sources are read again for the tickers on your board and a Headlines list opens above the table, grouped by ticker, newest first, each with the publisher, where it came from, the age and a one-line teaser. One line under the list says how many sources answered and names any that did not (e.g. "Unavailable: Finviz").

The News column keeps the MomoX3 look - the age plus a ✦ on every ticker that has a headline. The ✦ is green/red when the AI reader judged the story, otherwise tinted by the headline's own tone. Hover or tap it for the headline, publisher and link; the pop-up now also shows Fresh (under 24h) or Stored, the tone, and the teaser.
After every SCAN the news is refreshed in the background for the scanned tickers, so the column is current without pressing anything. The scan itself is never slowed or changed by news.
Older stored headlines (up to 7 days) now show as "Stored" instead of disappearing, so an empty News cell really means no publisher tagged the ticker this week.

releases.heading: Sector cards fold away
items: The HOT sector cards now have their own "v SECTORS" arrow above them: click to hide them, click again to show. Closed, one line still names every sector (🔥 for HOT), so nothing is hidden without a trace. Your choice is remembered.

releases.heading: MomoX A+: the High OI magnet is the stock's OWN biggest wall
items: No more fixed 1,000-contract minimum. The High OI piece now counts the stock's own biggest call wall above the price, within 2x the expected move - so a smaller stock like QMCO (35C, 739 contracts) counts. Hover the MX A+ tag to see the wall.
Still not back-tested (no open-interest history); the 4 PM scorecard tracks it.

releases.heading: Scanner shows only tickers that have options
items: The MomX scanner now scans ONLY tickers whose real option chain lists options - the same chain the ticker card uses, no hand-made list. Tickers with no options are not scanned at all (bull and bear). Next to TICKERS it says how many were left out, e.g. "11 no options" - hover to see which.

A new ticker (a new Mover, or one you type) is checked first - usually within a minute - and shows only if it has options. If the check cannot get an answer (Schwab down, still loading) the ticker waits as "checking"; it is never marked "no options" on a guess. Typing a ticker with no options now tells you so.

The W (weekly options) marker now comes from the real chains too: 328 of your 356 Watchlist tickers have weeklies. The old hand-made list was wrong for 157 of them (it missed 155 weekly names and wrongly marked MPC and NOC).
Movers: no-options names no longer take any of the 40 slots.

releases.heading: MomoX A+ now needs a High OI call wall
items: The MX A+ tag now also requires the fifth piece: a big call wall (1,000+ contracts) just above the price, within 2x the expected move - the same walls the ticker card shows. Hover the tag to see the strike, e.g. 750C (16,446 OI).

Only tickers already passing the other four pieces get their option chain checked, one every 15 seconds, so the scanner does not slow down. A tag can appear a minute later than before while the chain loads.
Open interest has no history, so this extra piece is NOT back-tested.

releases.heading: MomoX A+ tag
items: New violet-and-gold "MX A+ 09:35 W" tag in the Setup column: the competitor's A+ setup - news in the last 24h + RVOL cyan + a squeeze fire (2h, 4h, Daily or Weekly) + Skittles Daily, 2D, 3D, 4D, Weekly and Monthly all bullish (no ETFs). The first time it lines up today; W = the stock has weekly options. It lights the ⚡, flashes and pops a card like the other setups.

Back-test Sep 1-25: 39% hit +2% first, 35% hit -1.5% first, 37% ran +4% - the most of any rule tested; holding to the close did better than a tight stop. Not proven yet - the 4 PM scorecard now tracks it daily (with a held-to-close line).

releases.heading: ⚡ TODAY / NOW button, like MomoX3
items: The ⚡ filter is now one button, like ScannerX3: click to cycle ALL → ⚡ NOW → ⚡ TODAY. The number on it is how many names hold a live ⚡ right now. ⚡ TODAY = fired today and still in the upper half of its last hour; ⚡ NOW = passing the gates this second.

releases.heading: Scanner re-checks only the newest bars
items: Each scanner rebuild now re-uses the indicator values it already worked out and only recomputes the newest bars that changed - about 38% less work per rebuild. Checked on all 357 tickers: every value is identical to a full recompute.

releases.heading: Scanner refreshes sooner
items: The scanner used to rest for half as long as each rebuild took (up to 2 minutes) before starting the next one. It now rests about a fifth (at most 45 seconds), so new boards arrive sooner - the rebuild runs at the lowest computer priority, so your charts still come first.
Two internal speed-ups in how each ticker's timeframes are built (checked on 357 tickers: identical results).

releases.heading: LIVE ⚡ every second, like ScannerX3
items: The ⚡ next to a ticker is now LIVE: checked every second on the Schwab stream, not every 4 minutes. It lights when the stock passes the gates ($5+, last hour closed up, 4-hour volume above normal) and fires a signal (9x20, 4x8 or MACD cross, squeeze fire, or a volume spike on a green candle). Bright when fresh, fading over 2 hours, and it goes out the moment the price drops into the lower half of its last hour. Hover it to see what fired.
New ⚡ ALL / ⚡ TODAY / ⚡ NOW switch next to Scan matches only: TODAY shows the names whose ⚡ is on, NOW only those passing the gates this second.
New H/L⚡ sort: names at the top of an hour that really moved come first.
Tested against our own signals on 20 days: our GO and market-turn setups ran +4% two to four times as often as this ⚡ - use the ⚡ as a live watch light, not as the entry.

releases.heading: Scanner stays lean with the Five Pillars data
items: Behind the scenes: the checklist data is computed once per ticker instead of twice, and is left out of the History archive (History cards do not show the checklist), so the scanner and History do not get heavier.

releases.heading: Five Pillars checklist on every ticker card
items: Each ticker card now has a FIVE PILLARS box (the MomoX method): 01 Trend (EMA 9 > 21 > 50 on 30m), 02 Price action (squeeze on or fired up on 2h/4h), 03 Market structure (room left in today's expected move), 04 Sell target (nearest call wall, prior-day high, premarket high or psych level at least 1% above), 05 Buy signal (a 9x20 or MACD cross, a chart arrow or a squeeze fire in the last 30 minutes). Green ✅ / red ✖ per pillar and READY ✓ when all five agree. Being back-tested now - not proven yet.

releases.heading: ⚡ in the Setup column, like MomoX
items: An orange ⚡ now leads the Setup column when a GO, OPT, SOLO, TURN or 🔥 leader fired today, before the grade letter. It flashes for the first 10 minutes; hover it to see what fired.
The Explosive pattern icon changed from ⚡ to 💥, so ⚡ only ever means "a setup fired".

releases.heading: 🔥 HOT sectors survive a scanner restart
items: The morning's 🔥 HOT sectors are now saved to disk. Before, restarting the scanner (like today at 11:01) erased them, and a sector cannot turn 🔥 after 11:00 - so today's AI Data Centers and Defense flames were lost.

releases.heading: MomoX-style pop-up cards and flashing tickers
items: When a GO, OPT, SOLO, TURN or 🔥 leader fires, that ticker's card now pops up by itself (like the MomoX cards), with a flashing line "⚡ GO 09:40 · came 09:45 ET" and every signal on the ticker. Once per ticker per day, up to 3 at a time, on wide screens only. Turn it off with the new Pop-up cards box next to Scan matches only.
The ticker itself also flashes yellow in the Symbol column for the first 10 minutes after a setup fires.
Every ticker card (also when you click ⚡) now lists all of its signals on one ⚡ line.

releases.heading: Market turn alert + ⚠ 30m sellers warning
items: New: when SPY dips below its VWAP after 9:45 and then closes back above it (10:00-2:30), the scanner marks the 5 strongest names at that moment with a teal "TURN #1 11:05" tag and your phone gets one push. Strongest = above VWAP, up 1%+, 30-minute buyers in control (ADX 20+), no ETFs. 20-day test: 44% hit +2% first, 41% hit -1.5% first, 20% ran +4% - a small edge, not proven; the 4 PM scorecard now tracks it. Starts Monday (the scanner restarts after today's close).
New warning on setups: ⚠ 30m sellers - the 30-minute chart has sellers in control (-DI above +DI). In the test those entries won only 14-18% of the time.

releases.heading: 🔥 on the ticker too
items: Stocks listed in a HOT sector's box (its top 5 by % today) now carry a 🔥 right before the ticker in the Symbol column, e.g. 🔥BE, 🔥IONQ. Hover it to see its rank in the sector. Where money is going - not a tested buy signal on its own.

releases.heading: Moving-now sectors now show as 🔥 HOT
items: Sectors that used to show 🔸 moving now now show as 🔥 HOT - the sector box, its label and the industry name on each row. One name, one flame.
A leader's ▲vol now says which volume timeframe lit it, e.g. "ARQQ +3.2 ▲vol 1h" (RVOL on 15m, 30m or 1h at 1.0 or more).

releases.heading: Chart-arrow tags in lime
items: In the scanner's Setup column, the CALL2H / CALL4H / C2H / C4H tags that used to be yellow are now lime. The cyan ones stay cyan.

releases.heading: New tags in the Setup column flash
items: Anything new in the Setup column now flashes with a white ring for its first 10 minutes: GO, OPT, SOLO, 🔥 leader, SQZ fire and the chart arrows (CALL2H / CALL4H / C2H / C4H). The 10 minutes count from when the scanner first saw it, so a late-arriving arrow still gets its full flash.

releases.heading: Setups and filters back on, as before 9:30 this morning
items: FILTERS again offers Best setups, GO, OPT, SOLO, hot sectors and News + momentum, and the Setup column shows the ⭐ stars, GO, OPT, SOLO, 🔥 leaders, NEWS and ⚠ warnings again - exactly as this morning.
The new C2H / C4H and SQZ fire tags stay, and the columns (News, Event, frozen Industry / Symbol) are unchanged.

releases.heading: C2H / C4H arrows and SQZ fire in the Setup column
items: The Setup column now also shows the chart's short C2H / C4H arrows (like PYPL's C4H at 10:10 today) - only during market hours, 9:30 to 4:00, so the early-morning noise stays out.
New cyan-outline tag when the 2h or 4h squeeze fires, e.g. "SQZ 2h 10:07" (first fire of the day in market hours).
Both are shown so you can see them - they are not proven yet. A 30-day test is running; the Chart CALL2H / CALL4H filter still uses only the full CALL arrows.

releases.heading: Scanner back to yesterday: new setups switched off
items: The Setup column is back to how it was yesterday morning: your letter, ADX, CALL2H/CALL4H arrows and V2 / V3 / Daily 2 / G. The ⭐ stars, GO, OPT, SOLO, 🔥 hot-sector leaders, the NEWS setup tag and the ⚠ warnings are switched off.
FILTERS no longer offers Best setups, GO, OPT, SOLO, hot sectors or News + momentum; a saved Best setups choice now reads as Any. The industry boxes show plain participation again, without 🔥 / 🔸.
Kept as they are: the News and Event columns and the frozen Industry / Symbol columns. Everything switched off can be switched back on in one step.

releases.heading: Paused alerts no longer show on the chart
items: A paused alert (like "Paused @ Auto CALL OI 515.00") no longer draws a line or label on the chart. It is still in your Alerts list, where you can turn it back on.

releases.heading: Mag7 OI walls now read Schwab/TOS chains
items: The Mag7 OI walls board used Tradier, and your Tradier account is inactive, so it showed nothing. It now reads the option chains from Schwab/TOS (Tradier only as a backup). All 7 names load in about 2 seconds.

releases.heading: Premarket FEED card says BACKUP, not GAP
items: Your Tradier account is inactive, so the 4-7 AM candles come from the free Alpaca backup, about 15 minutes behind. The Premarket FEED card now says BACKUP (amber) instead of GAP / No data, because the candles are there - just a little late until about 7:15 AM.

releases.heading: Morning brief: SPY/QQQ and movers lines come back
items: On 9/24 and 9/25 the morning brief was missing the SPY/QQQ tape line and the gainers/losers lines. The server kept reusing a broken Schwab price connection that answered with nothing. Now an empty answer makes it reconnect on the next 5-minute build. Takes effect after the next backend restart.

releases.heading: Only Industry and Symbol stay frozen
items: When you swipe the scanner sideways, only Industry and Symbol stay on screen now. Time and Setup scroll with the rest. The order is still Industry, Symbol, Time, Setup.

releases.heading: Scanner columns: Industry | Symbol | Time frozen, then Setup
items: The column order is now Industry, Symbol, Time, Setup. When you swipe the board sideways, Industry, Symbol and Time stay on screen; Setup scrolls with the rest.
History uses the same order.

releases.heading: ⭐ order fixed: clean setups first
items: Inside the same group (GO or OPT), a setup with no ⚠ now gets the lower star number. Before, a GO with a ⚠ (like up 9% or fading) could be ⭐1 just because it came earlier.

releases.heading: News and Event columns, like MomoX
items: Two new columns next to % Chg. News shows how old the latest headline is (43m, 2h, 17h) - bright white when under 3 hours. A ✦ after it means the AI read the news: green = good news, red = bad news. Hover to read the headline.

Event shows the next earnings date (e.g. 11/2) with ☀ = before the open or ☾ = after the close. It turns amber when earnings are 7 days away or less - an option held through earnings can jump or get crushed.
Click either header to sort: newest news first, or nearest earnings first. You can move or hide them in Columns like any other column.

releases.heading: ⭐1, ⭐2 … on the best setups - no filter needed
items: You do not have to open FILTERS any more. On the normal scanner screen, the day's best setups (GO, or OPT seen before 10:00) now carry a gold ⭐1, ⭐2, ⭐3 … tag in the Setup column, in your tested order. ⭐1 is the top one by your rules. An amber ⚠ next to it means careful (a wrong-pick pattern like up big or fading).
Before 9:35 there are no stars - that is normal. No star all day = no setup that day.

releases.heading: Best setups is now ranked - best first, with ⚠ warnings
items: With ⭐ Best setups picked, the list is now in your tested order: GO inside a 🔥 hot or 🔸 moving-now sector first, then other GO, then OPT. Inside each group, cleaner names come first, then good news (NEWS ↑), then the earliest signal. Nothing else changed - same filter, same tags.

A setup that matches a wrong-pick pattern gets an amber ⚠ tag, e.g. '⚠ up 12% · fading': bad news (news ↓), already up 8%+, momentum fading, or price back under VWAP. Two or more warnings push it lower in the list.

releases.heading: FILTERS setup list is now grouped - one everyday choice on top
items: The A/A+ Setup dropdown is split into labelled sections: '⭐ Use every day' (Best setups - the only one you need), 'Letters only', 'Extra ideas (still being tested)', and 'My older strategies' (V2, V3, Daily 2, G, GO only, OPT only). Nothing was removed; it is just easier to find the one you use.

releases.heading: Fixed: 🔥 / 🔸 sector boxes printed their lines on top of each other
items: Inside each 🔥 hot and 🔸 moving-now box, the 'today / 3d / vol' line and the list of stocks now sit on their own full-width lines under the sector name, instead of overlapping and becoming unreadable.

releases.heading: BEAR scanner: the bull scan mirrored for puts
items: The scanner toolbar's BULL label is now a BULL / BEAR switch. Bear mode shows the same lists scored for the downside: crosses below, squeezes firing down, selling volume, biggest losers first.
Bear A+/A/B grade, momentum (Breakdown / Building down / Extended down), Best setups (GO = gap down and go, OPT = 2h+4h cross down) and Strategy G with PUT plans.
Bear results are recorded separately (its own track record starts today) so the bull numbers are unchanged. Chart: red A+/A circles on PUT labels.

releases.heading: V2, V3, Daily 2 and Strategy G are back in FILTERS
items: FILTERS > A/A+ Setup lists Strategy V2, V3, Daily 2 and Strategy G (my rules) again, plus 'GO only' and 'OPT only'. They never stopped running - they had only been hidden when Best setups became the default - and their V2 / V3 / D2 / G tags show in the Setup column again.
Fixed: a one-stock 'sector' (like AI-Infra with only TSSI) could show as a 🔸 moving-now box. A sector now needs at least 4 stocks.

releases.heading: BEAR scanner: the bull scan mirrored for puts
items: The scanner toolbar's BULL label is now a BULL / BEAR switch. Bear mode shows the same lists scored for the downside: crosses below, squeezes firing down, selling volume, biggest losers first.
Bear A+/A/B grade, momentum (Breakdown / Building down / Extended down), Best setups (GO = gap down and go, OPT = 2h+4h cross down) and Strategy G with PUT plans.
Bear results are recorded separately (its own track record starts today) so the bull numbers are unchanged. Chart: red A+/A circles on PUT labels.

releases.heading: Fixed: opening FILTERS crashed the screen
items: Clicking FILTERS showed 'The workspace stopped rendering - direction is not defined'. The filter panel now knows whether the scanner is on BULL or BEAR, and opens normally. Refresh the app to get the fix.

releases.heading: BEAR scanner: the bull scan mirrored for puts
items: The scanner toolbar's BULL label is now a BULL / BEAR switch. Bear mode shows the same lists scored for the downside: crosses below, squeezes firing down, selling volume, biggest losers first.
Bear A+/A/B grade, momentum (Breakdown / Building down / Extended down), Best setups (GO = gap down and go, OPT = 2h+4h cross down) and Strategy G with PUT plans.
Bear results are recorded separately (its own track record starts today) so the bull numbers are unchanged. Chart: red A+/A circles on PUT labels.

releases.heading: 🔸 'Moving now' sectors all day - would have caught Quantum and Space on Thursday
items: Besides the 🔥 hot sectors, up to 3 dashed 🔸 boxes now show the sectors that are moving right now, at any time from 09:35: the most of their stocks up and above VWAP (60%+), with a median move of +0.5% or more. Replaying Thursday: 🔸 Quantum at 10:30 and 🔸 Space at 10:40 - IONQ still had about +6% left, RKLB about +5%.
The boxes now show the sector's own moves like your Sector ETFs sheet - 'today +x%' and '3d +y%' - instead of comparing with SPY.

🔸 is information, not a trade by itself: the boxes rotate through several sectors during a morning (never more than 3 at once), and in the back-test later-starting sectors did not win more than they lost. Look for a GO / OPT inside them.

releases.heading: BEAR scanner: the bull scan mirrored for puts
items: The scanner toolbar's BULL label is now a BULL / BEAR switch. Bear mode shows the same lists scored for the downside: crosses below, squeezes firing down, selling volume, biggest losers first.
Bear A+/A/B grade, momentum (Breakdown / Building down / Extended down), Best setups (GO = gap down and go, OPT = 2h+4h cross down) and Strategy G with PUT plans.
Bear results are recorded separately (its own track record starts today) so the bull numbers are unchanged. Chart: red A+/A circles on PUT labels.

releases.heading: No dark green in H/L - pale mint like MomoX, on the board and the ticker card
items: Strong H/L readings now show pale mint everywhere, the same as MomoX - the ticker card was still drawing the old dark green. The board and the card now share one colour table, so they always match.
If you still see dark green, your screen is on the older version: refresh (or close and reopen the app).

releases.heading: BEAR scanner: the bull scan mirrored for puts
items: The scanner toolbar's BULL label is now a BULL / BEAR switch. Bear mode shows the same lists scored for the downside: crosses below, squeezes firing down, selling volume, biggest losers first.
Bear A+/A/B grade, momentum (Breakdown / Building down / Extended down), Best setups (GO = gap down and go, OPT = 2h+4h cross down) and Strategy G with PUT plans.
Bear results are recorded separately (its own track record starts today) so the bull numbers are unchanged. Chart: red A+/A circles on PUT labels.

releases.heading: H/L column now looks like MomoX
items: Each H/L cell is now one solid block from the left, like your MomoX screen: the wider the block, the closer the stock is to the top (or bottom) of its 16-hour range.
